Hi ! It's Boyoung ASMR. Today’s video is a first-person, no-talking makeup ASMR.

Up until now, most of my videos have been full of chatter… and I heard a rumor that I’ve never done a no-talking makeup video 😆

So here it is: a relaxing makeup session perfect for watching before bed!
There’s nothing like applying it directly on camera, right?

While making this video, I ended up unboxing some brand-new products,
and since people requested me to show the unboxing, I thought I’d include it.

I was wondering which products I should buy…
and then I noticed “flight attendant must-haves” popping up in the algorithm a few times,
so I decided to include a few of those 😄

And after trying them… wow!

Especially the foundation featured in the video!
It’s the shake-before-use type, and it’s amazing.
Even super dry skin looks glowy!
I wasn’t sure what “spa glow” meant at first, but yes… it really works!
(Make sure to shake before squeezing it out!)

Then there’s HINCE, a product known as a flight attendant favorite.
Just like in the video, dab it on the back of your hand and apply to the cheeks…
wow, it gives such a glow!

I also carefully picked out the eyeshadows myself.
There’s even a cream blush inside the palette that I loved!

I got so excited that I almost forgot to talk about the ASMR, haha 😅
I was just thrilled the products worked so well.

I also applied false eyelashes,
and I did some fine adjustments to make the left-right sound separation better—
I think the audio feels richer now.

My favorite sounds in this video?
The ampoule and cream make that nice thick, squishy sound… I love it 😍

Hi ! It's Boyoung ASMR. Today’s video is a first-person, no-talking makeup ASMR.

Up until now, most of my videos have been full of chatter… and I heard a rumor that I’ve never done a no-talking makeup video 😆

So here it is: a relaxing makeup session perfect for watching before bed!
There’s nothing like applying it directly on camera, right?

While making this video, I ended up unboxing some brand-new products,
and since people requested me to show the unboxing, I thought I’d include it.

I was wondering which products I should buy…
and then I noticed “flight attendant must-haves” popping up in the algorithm a few times,
so I decided to include a few of those 😄

And after trying them… wow!

Especially the foundation featured in the video!
It’s the shake-before-use type, and it’s amazing.
Even super dry skin looks glowy!
I wasn’t sure what “spa glow” meant at first, but yes… it really works!
(Make sure to shake before squeezing it out!)

Then there’s HINCE, a product known as a flight attendant favorite.
Just like in the video, dab it on the back of your hand and apply to the cheeks…
wow, it gives such a glow!

I also carefully picked out the eyeshadows myself.
There’s even a cream blush inside the palette that I loved!

I got so excited that I almost forgot to talk about the ASMR, haha 😅
I was just thrilled the products worked so well.

I also applied false eyelashes,
and I did some fine adjustments to make the left-right sound separation better—
I think the audio feels richer now.

My favorite sounds in this video?
The ampoule and cream make that nice thick, squishy sound… I love it 😍

흔들어서 쓰는건데 이거 대박 좋습니다

극건성도 광나게 하더라고요

섀도우 안에 크림형 볼터치가..마음에 들더라구요 !

메이크업템 성공해서 기뻣나봅니다ㅠㅠㅋㅋㅋ

속눈썹도 붙여드리구요!
그리고 소리 좌우 구분되는거에 미세조정 했더니
좀더 사운드가 풍부해진것 같았어요
어떤 소리가 좋냐면요?
앰플이랑 크림소리가 꾸덕꾸덕 맘에들었답니다


오늘도 반나잇입니다
반쪽이들 잘자요!!

Hi ! It's Boyoung ASMR. Today’s video is a first-person, no-talking makeup ASMR.

Up until now, most of my videos have been full of chatter… and I heard a rumor that I’ve never done a no-talking makeup video 😆

So here it is: a relaxing makeup session perfect for watching before bed!
There’s nothing like applying it directly on camera, right?

While making this video, I ended up unboxing some brand-new products,
and since people requested me to show the unboxing, I thought I’d include it.

I was wondering which products I should buy…
and then I noticed “flight attendant must-haves” popping up in the algorithm a few times,
so I decided to include a few of those 😄

And after trying them… wow!

Especially the foundation featured in the video!
It’s the shake-before-use type, and it’s amazing.
Even super dry skin looks glowy!
I wasn’t sure what “spa glow” meant at first, but yes… it really works!
(Make sure to shake before squeezing it out!)

Then there’s HINCE, a product known as a flight attendant favorite.
Just like in the video, dab it on the back of your hand and apply to the cheeks…
wow, it gives such a glow!

I also carefully picked out the eyeshadows myself.
There’s even a cream blush inside the palette that I loved!

I got so excited that I almost forgot to talk about the ASMR, haha 😅
I was just thrilled the products worked so well.

I also applied false eyelashes,
and I did some fine adjustments to make the left-right sound separation better—
I think the audio feels richer now.

My favorite sounds in this video?
The ampoule and cream make that nice thick, squishy sound… I love it 😍

Hi ! It's Boyoung ASMR. Today’s video is a first-person, no-talking makeup ASMR.

So here it is: a relaxing makeup session perfect for watching before bed!
There’s nothing like applying it directly on camera, right?

While making this video, I ended up unboxing some brand-new products,
and since people requested me to show the unboxing, I thought I’d include it.

I was wondering which products I should buy…
and then I noticed “flight attendant must-haves” popping up in the algorithm a few times,
so I decided to include a few of those 😄

Especially the foundation featured in the video!
It’s the shake-before-use type, and it’s amazing.

Just like in the video, dab it on the back of your hand and apply to the cheeks…
wow, it gives such a glow!

I also carefully picked out the eyeshadows myself.
There’s even a cream blush inside the palette that I loved!

I got so excited that I almost forgot to talk about the ASMR, haha 😅
I was just thrilled the products worked so well.

I also applied false eyelashes,
and I did some fine adjustments to make the left-right sound separation better—
I think the audio feels richer now.

My favorite sounds in this video?
The ampoule and cream make that nice thick, squishy sound… I love it 😍

snippet.title: ASMR🌊중독적인 귀막는 소리🌙 바닷속 이어커핑 귀마사지 |🐰용왕님! 저 그 토끼에요 [ 상황극 ] Underwater Ear Cupping & Ear Massage
snippet.description:
#asmr #asmr귀마사지 #asmr이어커핑

안녕하세요! 반보영 입니다!!
이어커핑 상황극 입니다! 
이어커핑 특유의 그 먹먹한 느낌이
잠수함 속? 또는 바닷속에 있는 느낌이 들더라구요 ㅎㅎ

내용은 제가 만든거라
오글거릴 수도 있어요

오늘 제 옷 좀 토끼같지 않나요?
네 저 오늘 토끼에요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

그 별주부전에서 토끼가 
육지에 간 두고왔다고 해서 도망쳤었잖아요

그치만 용왕님이 아팠던게 마음에 걸렸던 토끼가
다시 용왕님에게 찾아온 내용이에요
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
그때 거짓말 쳐서 다시왔다구 ..ㅋㅋㅋ
대신 더 좋은거 가지고 왔다고 합니다.

잡아먹힐수도 있지만
용기있게 다시 !!

육지동물이라서 오래못있겠다고 하는것도 있고
내용이 좀 웃기긴 한데
재밌게 들어주시면 좋겠어요!

이어커핑이 주를 이루고
거의 후반부에 귀마사지가 나와요

이게 보다보면 갑자기 막
마이크에 케이블선이 하나였다가 2개였다가 왔다갔다 바뀌는 씬들이 꽤나 있는데요.
케이블에 따라서 마이크 소리가 차이가 좀 있길래
같은내용 두번 촬영하고 
더 좋았던 소리를 그때그때 비교해서 골라서 이어 붙여서 그렇습니다ㅋㅋ

오늘도 반나잇 입니다 여러분!!

+ 오늘의 옷 정보는 태그 걸어놨습니당! (잠옷입니다 )

+ 그다음 영상 스포: 메이크업 1인칭


Hello! This is Ban Boyoung!!

Today’s video is an ear cupping roleplay,
inspired by a request one of my Ban-half viewers left in the comments!

That unique, slightly muffled feeling of ear cupping
kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

The story is something I made up myself,
so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?
Yes, I’m a rabbit today 😂🐰

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂
Saying he lied before… and that this time,
he brought something even better instead.

He might get eaten…
but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Since he’s a land animal, he says he can’t stay long,
so the story is a bit silly and funny,
but I hope you enjoy listening to it 💙

The video mainly focuses on ear cupping,
and ear massage comes out more toward the end.

Maybe because this is a new microphone,
the sound feels especially clear and nice!!!

And the first-person makeup video you’ve been requesting
is coming right next!
Please wait just a little longer—thank you so much 💕

こんにちは！バン・ボヨンです！！

今日は、
視聴者さん（バンハーフの皆さん）のコメントでリクエストをいただいた
イヤーカッピングのロールプレイ動画です！

イヤーカッピング特有の、あの少しこもった感じって
潜水艦の中とか、海の中にいるような感覚がしませんか？ㅎㅎ

ストーリーは私が考えたものなので、
ちょっと恥ずかしい（オーバー）かもしれません😂

今日の服装、ちょっとウサギっぽくないですか？
そう、今日はウサギですㅋㅋㅋㅋ 🐰

『別主夫伝（ピョルジュブジョン）』で、
ウサギが「肝を陸に置いてきた」と嘘をついて逃げた話、ありますよね。

今回はそのウサギが、
病気だった龍王様のことがずっと気になって、
もう一度会いに戻ってくる、というお話ですㅋㅋㅋ
「あの時は嘘ついてごめんなさい」って言いながら…
代わりにもっといいものを持ってきたそうです。

食べられちゃうかもしれないけど、
勇気を出して、もう一度！！

陸の動物だから長くはいられない、という設定もあって
ちょっと笑える内容ですが、
楽しく聴いてもらえたら嬉しいです✨

イヤーカッピングがメインで、
後半に耳マッサージが入ります。

新しいマイクだからか、
音がとてもクリアで良い感じだと思いました！！！

＋ そして、リクエストをいただいていた
メイクアップ1人称ASMRはその次の動画です！
もう少しだけお待ちいただけたら嬉しいです 💗

00:00 미리보기
01:38 바닷속에 도착한 토끼 (이어커핑 시작)
07:20 기압치료 (귀를 막았다 뗐다하는 이어커핑)
19:07 귀마사지

ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

대신 더 좋은거 가지고 왔다고 합니다.

재밌게 들어주시면 좋겠어요!

Hello! This is Ban Boyoung!!

Today’s video is an ear cupping roleplay,
inspired by a request one of my Ban-half viewers left in the comments!

That unique, slightly muffled feeling of ear cupping
kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

The story is something I made up myself,
so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?
Yes, I’m a rabbit today 😂🐰

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂
Saying he lied before… and that this time,
he brought something even better instead.

He might get eaten…
but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Since he’s a land animal, he says he can’t stay long,
so the story is a bit silly and funny,
but I hope you enjoy listening to it 💙

The video mainly focuses on ear cupping,
and ear massage comes out more toward the end.

Maybe because this is a new microphone,
the sound feels especially clear and nice!!!

And the first-person makeup video you’ve been requesting
is coming right next!
Please wait just a little longer—thank you so much 💕

イヤーカッピングのロールプレイ動画です！

イヤーカッピング特有の、あの少しこもった感じって
潜水艦の中とか、海の中にいるような感覚がしませんか？ㅎㅎ

ストーリーは私が考えたものなので、
ちょっと恥ずかしい（オーバー）かもしれません😂

今日の服装、ちょっとウサギっぽくないですか？
そう、今日はウサギですㅋㅋㅋㅋ 🐰

『別主夫伝（ピョルジュブジョン）』で、
ウサギが「肝を陸に置いてきた」と嘘をついて逃げた話、ありますよね。

今回はそのウサギが、
病気だった龍王様のことがずっと気になって、
もう一度会いに戻ってくる、というお話ですㅋㅋㅋ
「あの時は嘘ついてごめんなさい」って言いながら…
代わりにもっといいものを持ってきたそうです。

食べられちゃうかもしれないけど、
勇気を出して、もう一度！！

陸の動物だから長くはいられない、という設定もあって
ちょっと笑える内容ですが、
楽しく聴いてもらえたら嬉しいです✨

イヤーカッピングがメインで、
後半に耳マッサージが入ります。

新しいマイクだからか、
音がとてもクリアで良い感じだと思いました！！！

＋ そして、リクエストをいただいていた
メイクアップ1人称ASMRはその次の動画です！
もう少しだけお待ちいただけたら嬉しいです 💗

so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,

he brought something even better instead.

but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Hello! This is Ban Boyoung!!

Today’s video is an ear cupping roleplay,
inspired by a request one of my Ban-half viewers left in the comments!

That unique, slightly muffled feeling of ear cupping
kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

The story is something I made up myself,
so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?
Yes, I’m a rabbit today 😂🐰

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂
Saying he lied before… and that this time,
he brought something even better instead.

He might get eaten…
but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Since he’s a land animal, he says he can’t stay long,
so the story is a bit silly and funny,
but I hope you enjoy listening to it 💙

The video mainly focuses on ear cupping,
and ear massage comes out more toward the end.

Maybe because this is a new microphone,
the sound feels especially clear and nice!!!

And the first-person makeup video you’ve been requesting
is coming right next!
Please wait just a little longer—thank you so much 💕

イヤーカッピングのロールプレイ動画です！

イヤーカッピング特有の、あの少しこもった感じって
潜水艦の中とか、海の中にいるような感覚がしませんか？ㅎㅎ

ストーリーは私が考えたものなので、
ちょっと恥ずかしい（オーバー）かもしれません😂

今日の服装、ちょっとウサギっぽくないですか？
そう、今日はウサギですㅋㅋㅋㅋ 🐰

『別主夫伝（ピョルジュブジョン）』で、
ウサギが「肝を陸に置いてきた」と嘘をついて逃げた話、ありますよね。

今回はそのウサギが、
病気だった龍王様のことがずっと気になって、
もう一度会いに戻ってくる、というお話ですㅋㅋㅋ
「あの時は嘘ついてごめんなさい」って言いながら…
代わりにもっといいものを持ってきたそうです。

食べられちゃうかもしれないけど、
勇気を出して、もう一度！！

陸の動物だから長くはいられない、という設定もあって
ちょっと笑える内容ですが、
楽しく聴いてもらえたら嬉しいです✨

イヤーカッピングがメインで、
後半に耳マッサージが入ります。

新しいマイクだからか、
音がとてもクリアで良い感じだと思いました！！！

＋ そして、リクエストをいただいていた
メイクアップ1人称ASMRはその次の動画です！
もう少しだけお待ちいただけたら嬉しいです 💗

Hello! This is Ban Boyoung!!

Today’s video is an ear cupping roleplay,
inspired by a request one of my Ban-half viewers left in the comments!

That unique, slightly muffled feeling of ear cupping
kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

The story is something I made up myself,
so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?
Yes, I’m a rabbit today 😂🐰

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂
Saying he lied before… and that this time,
he brought something even better instead.

He might get eaten…
but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Since he’s a land animal, he says he can’t stay long,
so the story is a bit silly and funny,
but I hope you enjoy listening to it 💙

The video mainly focuses on ear cupping,
and ear massage comes out more toward the end.

Maybe because this is a new microphone,
the sound feels especially clear and nice!!!

And the first-person makeup video you’ve been requesting
is coming right next!
Please wait just a little longer—thank you so much 💕

こんにちは！バン・ボヨンです！！

今日は、
視聴者さん（バンハーフの皆さん）のコメントでリクエストをいただいた
イヤーカッピングのロールプレイ動画です！

イヤーカッピング特有の、あの少しこもった感じって
潜水艦の中とか、海の中にいるような感覚がしませんか？ㅎㅎ

ストーリーは私が考えたものなので、
ちょっと恥ずかしい（オーバー）かもしれません😂

今日の服装、ちょっとウサギっぽくないですか？
そう、今日はウサギですㅋㅋㅋㅋ 🐰

『別主夫伝（ピョルジュブジョン）』で、
ウサギが「肝を陸に置いてきた」と嘘をついて逃げた話、ありますよね。

今回はそのウサギが、
病気だった龍王様のことがずっと気になって、
もう一度会いに戻ってくる、というお話ですㅋㅋㅋ
「あの時は嘘ついてごめんなさい」って言いながら…
代わりにもっといいものを持ってきたそうです。

食べられちゃうかもしれないけど、
勇気を出して、もう一度！！

ちょっと笑える内容ですが、
楽しく聴いてもらえたら嬉しいです✨

イヤーカッピングがメインで、
後半に耳マッサージが入ります。

新しいマイクだからか、
音がとてもクリアで良い感じだと思いました！！！

メイクアップ1人称ASMRはその次の動画です！

kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

so it might be a little cringey 😆

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂

he brought something even better instead.

but he comes back bravely anyway!!

오늘은 반쪽이분들중 한분이 댓글로 적어주셨던 이어커핑!!
을 위한 상황극 입니다
이어커핑 특유의 그 먹먹한 느낌이
잠수함 속? 또는 바닷속에 있는 느낌이 들더라구요 ㅎㅎ

내용은 제가 만든거라
오글거릴 수도 있어요

오늘 제 옷 좀 토끼같지 않나요?
네 저 오늘 토끼에요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

그 별주부전에서 토끼가 
육지에 간 두고왔다고 해서 도망쳤었잖아요

그치만 용왕님이 아팠던게 마음에 걸렸던 토끼가
다시 용왕님에게 찾아온 내용이에요
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
그때 거짓말 쳐서 다시왔다구 ..ㅋㅋㅋ
대신 더 좋은거 가지고 왔다고 합니다.

잡아먹힐수도 있지만
용기있게 다시 !!

육지동물이라서 오래못있겠다고 하는것도 있고
내용이 좀 웃기긴 한데
재밌게 들어주시면 좋겠어요!

이어커핑이 주를 이루고
거의 후반부에 귀마사지가 나와요

이게 잘 보시면 
마이크에 케이블선이 하나였다가 2개였다가 왔다갔다 바뀌는 신들이 있을텐데요
케이블에 따라서 마이크 소리가 차이가 좀 있길래
같은내용 두번 촬영하고 
더 좋았던 소리를 골라서 이어 붙여서 그렇습니다

오늘도 반나잇 입니다 여러분!!

+ 오늘의 옷 정보는 태그 걸어놨습니당! (잠옷입니다 )

+ 그다음 영상 스포: 메이크업 1인칭


Hello! This is Ban Boyoung!!

Today’s video is an ear cupping roleplay,
inspired by a request one of my Ban-half viewers left in the comments!

That unique, slightly muffled feeling of ear cupping
kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

The story is something I made up myself,
so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?
Yes, I’m a rabbit today 😂🐰

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂
Saying he lied before… and that this time,
he brought something even better instead.

He might get eaten…
but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Since he’s a land animal, he says he can’t stay long,
so the story is a bit silly and funny,
but I hope you enjoy listening to it 💙

The video mainly focuses on ear cupping,
and ear massage comes out more toward the end.

Maybe because this is a new microphone,
the sound feels especially clear and nice!!!

And the first-person makeup video you’ve been requesting
is coming right next!
Please wait just a little longer—thank you so much 💕

こんにちは！バン・ボヨンです！！

今日は、
視聴者さん（バンハーフの皆さん）のコメントでリクエストをいただいた
イヤーカッピングのロールプレイ動画です！

イヤーカッピング特有の、あの少しこもった感じって
潜水艦の中とか、海の中にいるような感覚がしませんか？ㅎㅎ

ストーリーは私が考えたものなので、
ちょっと恥ずかしい（オーバー）かもしれません😂

今日の服装、ちょっとウサギっぽくないですか？
そう、今日はウサギですㅋㅋㅋㅋ 🐰

『別主夫伝（ピョルジュブジョン）』で、
ウサギが「肝を陸に置いてきた」と嘘をついて逃げた話、ありますよね。

今回はそのウサギが、
病気だった龍王様のことがずっと気になって、
もう一度会いに戻ってくる、というお話ですㅋㅋㅋ
「あの時は嘘ついてごめんなさい」って言いながら…
代わりにもっといいものを持ってきたそうです。

食べられちゃうかもしれないけど、
勇気を出して、もう一度！！

陸の動物だから長くはいられない、という設定もあって
ちょっと笑える内容ですが、
楽しく聴いてもらえたら嬉しいです✨

イヤーカッピングがメインで、
後半に耳マッサージが入ります。

新しいマイクだからか、
音がとてもクリアで良い感じだと思いました！！！

＋ そして、リクエストをいただいていた
メイクアップ1人称ASMRはその次の動画です！
もう少しだけお待ちいただけたら嬉しいです 💗

Hello! This is Ban Boyoung!!

Today’s video is an ear cupping roleplay,
inspired by a request one of my Ban-half viewers left in the comments!

That unique, slightly muffled feeling of ear cupping
kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

The story is something I made up myself,
so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?
Yes, I’m a rabbit today 😂🐰

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂
Saying he lied before… and that this time,
he brought something even better instead.

He might get eaten…
but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Since he’s a land animal, he says he can’t stay long,
so the story is a bit silly and funny,
but I hope you enjoy listening to it 💙

The video mainly focuses on ear cupping,
and ear massage comes out more toward the end.

Maybe because this is a new microphone,
the sound feels especially clear and nice!!!

And the first-person makeup video you’ve been requesting
is coming right next!
Please wait just a little longer—thank you so much 💕

今日の服装、ちょっとウサギっぽくないですか？

오늘은 반쪽이분들중 한분이 댓글로 적어주셨던 이어커핑!!
을 위한 상황극 입니다
이어커핑 특유의 그 먹먹한 느낌이
잠수함 속? 또는 바닷속에 있는 느낌이 들더라구요 ㅎㅎ

내용은 제가 만든거라
오글거릴 수도 있어요

오늘 제 옷 좀 토끼같지 않나요?
네 저 오늘 토끼에요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

그 별주부전에서 토끼가 
육지에 간 두고왔다고 해서 도망쳤었잖아요

그치만 용왕님이 아팠던게 마음에 걸렸던 토끼가
다시 용왕님에게 찾아온 내용이에요
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
그때 거짓말 쳐서 다시왔다구 ..ㅋㅋㅋ
대신 더 좋은거 가지고 왔다고 합니다.

잡아먹힐수도 있지만
용기있게 다시 !!

육지동물이라서 오래못있겠다고 하는것도 있고
내용이 좀 웃기긴 한데
재밌게 들어주시면 좋겠어요!

이어커핑이 주를 이루고
거의 후반부에 귀마사지가 나와요

이게 잘 보시면 
마이크에 케이블선이 하나였다가 2개였다가 왔다갔다 바뀌는 신들이 있을텐데요
케이블에 따라서 마이크 소리가 차이가 좀 있길래
같은내용 두번 촬영하고 
더 좋았던 소리를 골라서 이어 붙여서 그렇습니다

오늘도 반나잇 입니다 여러분!!

+ 오늘의 옷 정보는 태그 걸어놨습니당! (잠옷입니다 )

+ 그다음 영상 스포: 메이크업 1인칭


Hello! This is Ban Boyoung!!

Today’s video is an ear cupping roleplay,
inspired by a request one of my Ban-half viewers left in the comments!

That unique, slightly muffled feeling of ear cupping
kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

The story is something I made up myself,
so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?
Yes, I’m a rabbit today 😂🐰

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂
Saying he lied before… and that this time,
he brought something even better instead.

He might get eaten…
but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Since he’s a land animal, he says he can’t stay long,
so the story is a bit silly and funny,
but I hope you enjoy listening to it 💙

The video mainly focuses on ear cupping,
and ear massage comes out more toward the end.

Maybe because this is a new microphone,
the sound feels especially clear and nice!!!

And the first-person makeup video you’ve been requesting
is coming right next!
Please wait just a little longer—thank you so much 💕

こんにちは！バン・ボヨンです！！

今日は、
視聴者さん（バンハーフの皆さん）のコメントでリクエストをいただいた
イヤーカッピングのロールプレイ動画です！

イヤーカッピング特有の、あの少しこもった感じって
潜水艦の中とか、海の中にいるような感覚がしませんか？ㅎㅎ

ストーリーは私が考えたものなので、
ちょっと恥ずかしい（オーバー）かもしれません😂

今日の服装、ちょっとウサギっぽくないですか？
そう、今日はウサギですㅋㅋㅋㅋ 🐰

『別主夫伝（ピョルジュブジョン）』で、
ウサギが「肝を陸に置いてきた」と嘘をついて逃げた話、ありますよね。

今回はそのウサギが、
病気だった龍王様のことがずっと気になって、
もう一度会いに戻ってくる、というお話ですㅋㅋㅋ
「あの時は嘘ついてごめんなさい」って言いながら…
代わりにもっといいものを持ってきたそうです。

食べられちゃうかもしれないけど、
勇気を出して、もう一度！！

陸の動物だから長くはいられない、という設定もあって
ちょっと笑える内容ですが、
楽しく聴いてもらえたら嬉しいです✨

イヤーカッピングがメインで、
後半に耳マッサージが入ります。

新しいマイクだからか、
音がとてもクリアで良い感じだと思いました！！！

＋ そして、リクエストをいただいていた
メイクアップ1人称ASMRはその次の動画です！
もう少しだけお待ちいただけたら嬉しいです 💗

Today’s video is an ear cupping roleplay,
inspired by a request one of my Ban-half viewers left in the comments!

That unique, slightly muffled feeling of ear cupping
kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

The story is something I made up myself,
so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?
Yes, I’m a rabbit today 😂🐰

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂
Saying he lied before… and that this time,
he brought something even better instead.

He might get eaten…
but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Since he’s a land animal, he says he can’t stay long,
so the story is a bit silly and funny,
but I hope you enjoy listening to it 💙

The video mainly focuses on ear cupping,
and ear massage comes out more toward the end.

Maybe because this is a new microphone,
the sound feels especially clear and nice!!!

And the first-person makeup video you’ve been requesting
is coming right next!

Hello! This is Ban Boyoung!!

Today’s video is an ear cupping roleplay,
inspired by a request one of my Ban-half viewers left in the comments!

That unique, slightly muffled feeling of ear cupping
kind of feels like being inside a submarine… or under the sea, doesn’t it? haha

The story is something I made up myself,
so it might be a little cringey 😆

Doesn’t my outfit look kind of like a rabbit today?
Yes, I’m a rabbit today 😂🐰

You know the classic tale Byeoljubujeon,
where the rabbit escapes after saying he left his liver on land, right?

This story is about that rabbit—
who couldn’t stop worrying about the Dragon King being sick,
so he comes back to see him again 😂
Saying he lied before… and that this time,
he brought something even better instead.

He might get eaten…
but he comes back bravely anyway!!

Since he’s a land animal, he says he can’t stay long,
so the story is a bit silly and funny,
but I hope you enjoy listening to it 💙

The video mainly focuses on ear cupping,
and ear massage comes out more toward the end.

Maybe because this is a new microphone,
the sound feels especially clear and nice!!!

And the first-person makeup video you’ve been requesting
is coming right next!
Please wait just a little longer—thank you so much 💕

今日は、
視聴者さん（バンハーフの皆さん）のコメントでリクエストをいただいた
イヤーカッピングのロールプレイ動画です！

イヤーカッピング特有の、あの少しこもった感じって
潜水艦の中とか、海の中にいるような感覚がしませんか？ㅎㅎ

ストーリーは私が考えたものなので、
ちょっと恥ずかしい（オーバー）かもしれません😂

今日の服装、ちょっとウサギっぽくないですか？
そう、今日はウサギですㅋㅋㅋㅋ 🐰

『別主夫伝（ピョルジュブジョン）』で、
ウサギが「肝を陸に置いてきた」と嘘をついて逃げた話、ありますよね。

今回はそのウサギが、
病気だった龍王様のことがずっと気になって、
もう一度会いに戻ってくる、というお話ですㅋㅋㅋ

後半に耳マッサージが入ります。

メイクアップ1人称ASMRはその次の動画です！

Hello everyone! It’s Ban Boyoung 💕
Shall we go see the autumn leaves together today? 🍁

Today’s video is a POV ASMR, and I made a maple tree using stickers!
Sticker sounds are surprisingly calming —
the sound of touching them with my hands,
and the sound of peeling and sticking… they’re both so satisfying.

There’s also a part where I’m choosing the stickers one by one,
and that soft rustling sound turned out to be super sleepy and relaxing.
A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

It’s autumn… (well, while editing I realized the season has passed… winter is coming 🤣)
I kept imagining going on a fall trip with you all,
and in the end, I traveled using stickers instead 🍂 lol

There are two autumn themes today!

1️⃣ The first theme is a red-and-orange maple tree —
I wanted to express a very “tree-tree” autumn vibe 🍁🌳
2️⃣ The second theme is a yellowish flower —
a warm and soft autumn feeling with flowers 🌼

To make it feel more 3D and realistic,
I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!
So you’ll see me moving back and forth between both sides 😂

Spoilers for the next videos ✨

1.Ear cupping (Turtle & Hare fairytale chaotic side-story) — requested in comments
2.Pink-pink POV makeup — requested in comments
3.“Happiness of December” — beginning of an ear-cleaning compilation (requested by… Ban Boyoung? 😂)

Good night 🌙
Ban-night 💕

みんなと紅葉旅行に行くことを想像していたら、
いつの間にかステッカーで旅行しちゃいました🍂笑

やわらかくてあったかい秋のイメージです

立体感を出すために、
ガラスの表と裏の両方にステッカーを貼っています！
なので前後を行ったり来たりしながら貼っていきます 😂

스티커가 은근히 손으로 만지는 소리도 좋고,
붙였다 떼는 소리도 팅글팅글 해요!

전체적인 조명 빛이 노을 빛 느낌이라서

간질간질 거리는 팅글느낌? 또, 소리도 은근 졸렸어요
꼭 고르는거부터 보세요 !!

사부작 사부작 컨텐츠 ㅎㅎ

가을이잖아요 (사실 편집하다가 시기가 좀 지났..이제 겨울오겠)
여러분들이랑 단풍여행..상상만 하다가
스티커로 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ떠나보게 되었네요!

총 2가지의 가을 테마가 나오는데요!

첫번째 테마는 울긋불긋 단풍나무! 나무나무 한걸 표현하고 싶었구요
두번째 테마는 노랑노랑한 꽃! 꽃이 있는 가을 느낌을 표현하고 싶었어요

스티커를 유리 앞뒷면에 붙여야 원근감이 살면서
입체적이 되더라구요!
그래서 앞면 뒷면 왔다갔다 하면서 붙입니다!ㅋㅋ

킬포 스티커는 '다람쥐 스티커'
넘 귀엽.....ㅎㅎ

따뜻하게 잘자요:)
반나잇!

09:21 빨강색위주 단풍잎 스티커들 보여주고 골라보기 (Showing red-tone maple leaf stickers and choosing one)

28:57 스티커 다 떼버리기! (Removing all the stickers!)

30:00 스티커 하나씩 붙이기 (Placing stickers one by one)

37:29 핀셋소리만 잠깐하고 여행 끝! (A short tweezer-only sound moment and the trip ends!)



Hello everyone! It’s Ban Boyoung 💕
Shall we go see the autumn leaves together today? 🍁

Today’s video is a POV ASMR, and I made a maple tree using stickers!
Sticker sounds are surprisingly calming —
the sound of touching them with my hands,
and the sound of peeling and sticking… they’re both so satisfying.

There’s also a part where I’m choosing the stickers one by one,
and that soft rustling sound turned out to be super sleepy and relaxing.
A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

It’s autumn… (well, while editing I realized the season has passed… winter is coming 🤣)
I kept imagining going on a fall trip with you all,
and in the end, I traveled using stickers instead 🍂 lol

There are two autumn themes today!

1️⃣ The first theme is a red-and-orange maple tree —
I wanted to express a very “tree-tree” autumn vibe 🍁🌳
2️⃣ The second theme is a yellowish flower —
a warm and soft autumn feeling with flowers 🌼

To make it feel more 3D and realistic,
I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!
So you’ll see me moving back and forth between both sides 😂

Spoilers for the next videos ✨

1.Ear cupping (Turtle & Hare fairytale chaotic side-story) — requested in comments
2.Pink-pink POV makeup — requested in comments
3.“Happiness of December” — beginning of an ear-cleaning compilation (requested by… Ban Boyoung? 😂)

Good night 🌙
Ban-night 💕

Today’s video is a POV ASMR, and I made a maple tree using stickers!
Sticker sounds are surprisingly calming —
the sound of touching them with my hands,
and the sound of peeling and sticking… they’re both so satisfying.

There’s also a part where I’m choosing the stickers one by one,
and that soft rustling sound turned out to be super sleepy and relaxing.
A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

It’s autumn… (well, while editing I realized the season has passed… winter is coming 🤣)
I kept imagining going on a fall trip with you all,
and in the end, I traveled using stickers instead 🍂 lol

There are two autumn themes today!

1️⃣ The first theme is a red-and-orange maple tree —
I wanted to express a very “tree-tree” autumn vibe 🍁🌳
2️⃣ The second theme is a yellowish flower —
a warm and soft autumn feeling with flowers 🌼

To make it feel more 3D and realistic,
I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!
So you’ll see me moving back and forth between both sides 😂

Spoilers for the next videos ✨

1.Ear cupping (Turtle & Hare fairytale chaotic side-story) — requested in comments

Good night 🌙

and the sound of peeling and sticking… they’re both so satisfying.

and that soft rustling sound turned out to be super sleepy and relaxing.
A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

It’s autumn… (well, while editing I realized the season has passed… winter is coming 🤣)
I kept imagining going on a fall trip with you all,
and in the end, I traveled using stickers instead 🍂 lol

I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!

Shall we go see the autumn leaves together today? 🍁

Today’s video is a POV ASMR, and I made a maple tree using stickers!
Sticker sounds are surprisingly calming —
the sound of touching them with my hands,
and the sound of peeling and sticking… they’re both so satisfying.

There’s also a part where I’m choosing the stickers one by one,
and that soft rustling sound turned out to be super sleepy and relaxing.
A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

It’s autumn… (well, while editing I realized the season has passed… winter is coming 🤣)
I kept imagining going on a fall trip with you all,
and in the end, I traveled using stickers instead 🍂 lol

There are two autumn themes today!

1️⃣ The first theme is a red-and-orange maple tree —
I wanted to express a very “tree-tree” autumn vibe 🍁🌳
2️⃣ The second theme is a yellowish flower —
a warm and soft autumn feeling with flowers 🌼

To make it feel more 3D and realistic,
I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!
So you’ll see me moving back and forth between both sides 😂

Spoilers for the next videos ✨

1.Ear cupping (Turtle & Hare fairytale chaotic side-story) — requested in comments
2.Pink-pink POV makeup — requested in comments
3.“Happiness of December” — beginning of an ear-cleaning compilation (requested by… Ban Boyoung? 😂)

Good night 🌙

스티커로 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ떠나보게 되었네요!

Shall we go see the autumn leaves together today? 🍁

Today’s video is a POV ASMR, and I made a maple tree using stickers!
Sticker sounds are surprisingly calming —
the sound of touching them with my hands,
and the sound of peeling and sticking… they’re both so satisfying.

There’s also a part where I’m choosing the stickers one by one,
and that soft rustling sound turned out to be super sleepy and relaxing.
A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

It’s autumn… (well, while editing I realized the season has passed… winter is coming 🤣)
I kept imagining going on a fall trip with you all,
and in the end, I traveled using stickers instead 🍂 lol

There are two autumn themes today!

1️⃣ The first theme is a red-and-orange maple tree —
I wanted to express a very “tree-tree” autumn vibe 🍁🌳
2️⃣ The second theme is a yellowish flower —
a warm and soft autumn feeling with flowers 🌼

To make it feel more 3D and realistic,
I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!
So you’ll see me moving back and forth between both sides 😂

Spoilers for the next videos ✨

2.Pink-pink POV makeup — requested in comments
3.“Happiness of December” — beginning of an ear-cleaning compilation (requested by… Ban Boyoung? 😂)

Good night 🌙

A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

It’s autumn… (well, while editing I realized the season has passed… winter is coming 🤣)

2️⃣ The second theme is a yellowish flower —

I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!

3.“Happiness of December” — beginning of an ear-cleaning compilation (requested by… Ban Boyoung? 😂)

Good night 🌙

A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

I kept imagining going on a fall trip with you all,

I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!

Shall we go see the autumn leaves together today? 🍁

Today’s video is a POV ASMR, and I made a maple tree using stickers!
Sticker sounds are surprisingly calming —
the sound of touching them with my hands,
and the sound of peeling and sticking… they’re both so satisfying.

There’s also a part where I’m choosing the stickers one by one,
and that soft rustling sound turned out to be super sleepy and relaxing.
A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

It’s autumn… (well, while editing I realized the season has passed… winter is coming 🤣)
I kept imagining going on a fall trip with you all,
and in the end, I traveled using stickers instead 🍂 lol

There are two autumn themes today!

1️⃣ The first theme is a red-and-orange maple tree —
I wanted to express a very “tree-tree” autumn vibe 🍁🌳
2️⃣ The second theme is a yellowish flower —
a warm and soft autumn feeling with flowers 🌼

To make it feel more 3D and realistic,
I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!
So you’ll see me moving back and forth between both sides 😂

Spoilers for the next videos ✨

1.Ear cupping (Turtle & Hare fairytale chaotic side-story) — requested in comments
2.Pink-pink POV makeup — requested in comments
3.“Happiness of December” — beginning of an ear-cleaning compilation (requested by… Ban Boyoung? 😂)

Good night 🌙

저랑 단풍 보러가시죠. 여러분 .
오늘은 1인칭 영상인데 스티커로 단풍나무를 만들어 봤어요!
스티커가 은근히 손으로 만지는 소리도 좋고,
붙였다 떼는 소리도 팅글팅글 해요!

전체적인 조명 빛이 노을 빛 느낌이라서
눈이 스르르르 감길지도요! (전 편집하다 졸렸어요)

아, 스티커 고르느라고 사부작 거리는 장면이 꽤나 있는데
간질간질 거리는 팅글느낌? 또, 소리도 은근 졸렸어요
꼭 고르는거부터 보세요 !!

사부작 사부작 컨텐츠 ㅎㅎ

가을이잖아요 (사실 편집하다가 시기가 좀 지났..이제 겨울오겠)
여러분들이랑 단풍여행..상상만 하다가
스티커로 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ떠나보게 되었네요!

총 2가지의 가을 테마가 나오는데요!

첫번째 테마는 울긋불긋 단풍나무! 나무나무 한걸 표현하고 싶었구요
두번째 테마는 노랑노랑한 꽃! 꽃이 있는 가을 느낌을 표현하고 싶었어요

스티커를 유리 앞뒷면에 붙여야 원근감이 살면서
입체적이 되더라구요!
그래서 앞면 뒷면 왔다갔다 하면서 붙입니다!ㅋㅋ

킬포 스티커는 '다람쥐 스티커'
넘 귀엽.....ㅎㅎ

따뜻하게 잘자요:)
반나잇!

02:04 핀셋들 소개(Led 불빛 트리거) (Introducing the tweezers (LED light trigger))

07:20 갈색 단풍잎 스티커들 보여주고 골라보기 (Showing brown maple leaf stickers and choosing one)
09:21 빨강색위주 단풍잎 스티커들 보여주고 골라보기 (Showing red-tone maple leaf stickers and choosing one)
11:03 노랑색위주 꽃 스티커들 보여주고 골라보기 (Showing yellow-tone flower stickers and choosing one)
12:20 여기서부터 진성말고 속삭임 시작 (Switching from normal voice to whispering)

28:57 스티커 다 떼버리기! (Removing all the stickers!)

[스티커 붙이기 시작: 가을꽃 테마]★ (Start sticker placing: Autumn flower theme)

30:00 스티커 하나씩 붙이기 (Placing stickers one by one)
30:57 급 노란조명으로 바꾸고 다시 스티커 붙이기 (Suddenly switching to yellow lighting and placing stickers again)
37:29 핀셋소리만 잠깐하고 여행 끝! (A short tweezer-only sound moment and the trip ends!)



Hello everyone! It’s Ban Boyoung 💕
Shall we go see the autumn leaves together today? 🍁

Today’s video is a POV ASMR, and I made a maple tree using stickers!
Sticker sounds are surprisingly calming —
the sound of touching them with my hands,
and the sound of peeling and sticking… they’re both so satisfying.

There’s also a part where I’m choosing the stickers one by one,
and that soft rustling sound turned out to be super sleepy and relaxing.
A true rustle-rustle content moment 😆

It’s autumn… (well, while editing I realized the season has passed… winter is coming 🤣)
I kept imagining going on a fall trip with you all,
and in the end, I traveled using stickers instead 🍂 lol

There are two autumn themes today!

1️⃣ The first theme is a red-and-orange maple tree —
I wanted to express a very “tree-tree” autumn vibe 🍁🌳
2️⃣ The second theme is a yellowish flower —
a warm and soft autumn feeling with flowers 🌼

To make it feel more 3D and realistic,
I placed the stickers on both the front and the back of the glass!
So you’ll see me moving back and forth between both sides 😂

Spoilers for the next videos ✨

1.Ear cupping (Turtle & Hare fairytale chaotic side-story) — requested in comments
2.Pink-pink POV makeup — requested in comments
3.“Happiness of December” — beginning of an ear-cleaning compilation (requested by… Ban Boyoung? 😂)

Good night 🌙
Ban-night 💕

snippet.description:
#ASMR #asmrearcleaning #asmr귀청소

드디어 ㅠㅠ옛날 소리가 복귀!! (옷도 마침 5년전 옷 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ)
저 사실, 저만의 고충이 있었습니다. 
처음에 샀던 그 흰색3Dio 마이크 소리가 너무 그리웠어요
저는 지금까지 흰색 3dio를 3개인가를 재구매 했었는데요
(험하게 다뤄서 전부 고장 이슈로 다시 사곤 했습니다 )

그런데 ,
처음에 샀던 3dio 만한 소리가 안 나는거 예요
매번 그게 저의 은근한 스트레스였어요 ㅠㅠ

두번째 샀던 건 귀이개가 닿으면 웅웅 거리는 이슈가
세번째꺼는 귓속 검정색 스티커가 얇아서 고막이 많이 보이는 상태?
첫번째랑 많이 달랐어요 
그래서 소리가 점점 옛날같지가 않았던 거에요 
ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ

소리에 민감하신 분들은 벌써 눈치채시고

none of them sounded as good as the very first one.

😭😭😭

and my ear-cleaning videos naturally became a bit less popular.

but it became harder and harder to recreate the old ear-cleaning sound,
so I ended up doing less of those videos too…

like it was some kind of sacred ritual for the video 😂

IT HAPPENED.
The old sound came back.
While scratching with the metal ear pick in the recording,
I literally almost cried… because I was so happy LOL

I just wanted to scratch all day.

Okay okay, that was way too long 😂
Now the main point!

I finally did the ear-cleaning video again,
and there’s something I really recommend you listen for.

There are three types of wooden ear picks in the video:

Wooden ear pick #1 — Very rough

Wooden ear pick #2 — Medium rough ★

Wooden ear pick #3 — Less rough ★

Please listen to #2 and #3 especially!!!!!!!!

And also the metal ear pick AND finger ear-cleaning are MUST-LISTENS!!!!! ★★★★★

My “December happiness project.” I really want to do it.

세번째꺼는 귓속 검정색 스티커가 얇아서 고막이 많이보이는 상태?
첫번째랑 많이 달랐어요 
그래서 소리가 점점 옛날같지가 않았던 거에요 
ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ

그 뒤로 편집으로 애를 썼지만

괜히 옷도 5~6년전 옷 꺼내입고 경건하게 영상찍고 있는데

헐.. 옛날 그 소리가 나는거에요
실제로 영상에서 쇠귀이개 긁다가 눈물날뻔했어요
행복해서 ㅋㅋㅋ

하루종일 긁고 싶더라구요!!

---------------------

아 그래서 귀청소를 했는데

1번 나무귀이개 - 매우거침

12월의 행복, 꼭 해보고 싶어요

잘자요 여러분 :)

Finally… the old sound is BACK 😭😭 (and I randomly ended up wearing a 5-year-old outfit too LOL)

So, I had a little personal struggle for a long time.
I really missed the sound of the very first white 3Dio mic I bought 7 years ago.

I actually re-purchased the white 3Dio… I think three times?
(They all broke because I treated them pretty roughly, so I kept buying new ones…)

But no matter what I bought,
none of them sounded as good as the very first one.
And honestly… that became a low-key stress for me 😭

The second one had that annoying bzzzz noise whenever the ear pick touched it.
The third one had the inner black sticker so thin that the eardrum area was too exposed(?)
It sounded really different from the first mic.
So the sound kept drifting away from the “old” classic sound…
😭😭😭

People who are sensitive to sound had already noticed it,
and my ear-cleaning videos naturally became a bit less popular.

I tried my best in editing afterwards,
but it became harder and harder to recreate the old ear-cleaning sound,
so I ended up doing less of those videos too…

But you know this already, right?
I’m an ear-cleaning maniac.
I LOVE ear cleaning ASMR.
Not being able to do it the way I wanted was torture 😭

So this time I said, “Let’s buy another one and try again!”
And I did!!
And I even put on an outfit from 5–6 years ago for no reason,
like it was some kind of sacred ritual for the video 😂

And then—
IT HAPPENED.
The old sound came back.
While scratching with the metal ear pick in the recording,
I literally almost cried… because I was so happy LOL

I just wanted to scratch all day.

Okay okay, that was way too long 😂
Now the main point!

I finally did the ear-cleaning video again,
and there’s something I really recommend you listen for.

There are three types of wooden ear picks in the video:

Wooden ear pick #1 — Very rough

Wooden ear pick #2 — Medium rough ★

Wooden ear pick #3 — Less rough ★

Please listen to #2 and #3 especially!!!!!!!!

And also the metal ear pick AND finger ear-cleaning are MUST-LISTENS!!!!! ★★★★★
Five stars LMAO

I think in December I’m going to go FULL ear-cleaning mode and just dig into ear-picks only 😂
My “December happiness project.” I really want to do it.

Good night everyone :) 🌙

괜히 옷도 5~6년전 옷 꺼내입고 경건하게 영상찍고 있는데

실제로 영상에서 쇠귀이개 긁다가 눈물날뻔했어요
행복해서 ㅋㅋㅋ

하루종일 긁고 싶더라구요!!

---------------------

12월의 행복, 꼭 해보고 싶어요

잘자요 여러분 :)

Finally… the old sound is BACK 😭😭 (and I randomly ended up wearing a 5-year-old outfit too LOL)

So, I had a little personal struggle for a long time.
I really missed the sound of the very first white 3Dio mic I bought 7 years ago.

I actually re-purchased the white 3Dio… I think three times?
(They all broke because I treated them pretty roughly, so I kept buying new ones…)

But no matter what I bought,
none of them sounded as good as the very first one.
And honestly… that became a low-key stress for me 😭

The second one had that annoying bzzzz noise whenever the ear pick touched it.
The third one had the inner black sticker so thin that the eardrum area was too exposed(?)
It sounded really different from the first mic.
So the sound kept drifting away from the “old” classic sound…
😭😭😭

People who are sensitive to sound had already noticed it,
and my ear-cleaning videos naturally became a bit less popular.

I tried my best in editing afterwards,
but it became harder and harder to recreate the old ear-cleaning sound,
so I ended up doing less of those videos too…

But you know this already, right?
I’m an ear-cleaning maniac.
I LOVE ear cleaning ASMR.
Not being able to do it the way I wanted was torture 😭

So this time I said, “Let’s buy another one and try again!”
And I did!!
And I even put on an outfit from 5–6 years ago for no reason,
like it was some kind of sacred ritual for the video 😂

And then—
IT HAPPENED.
The old sound came back.
While scratching with the metal ear pick in the recording,
I literally almost cried… because I was so happy LOL

I just wanted to scratch all day.

Okay okay, that was way too long 😂
Now the main point!

I finally did the ear-cleaning video again,
and there’s something I really recommend you listen for.

There are three types of wooden ear picks in the video:

Wooden ear pick #1 — Very rough

Wooden ear pick #2 — Medium rough ★

Wooden ear pick #3 — Less rough ★

Please listen to #2 and #3 especially!!!!!!!!

And also the metal ear pick AND finger ear-cleaning are MUST-LISTENS!!!!! ★★★★★
Five stars LMAO

I think in December I’m going to go FULL ear-cleaning mode and just dig into ear-picks only 😂
My “December happiness project.” I really want to do it.

Good night everyone :) 🌙

😭😭😭

and my ear-cleaning videos naturally became a bit less popular.

but it became harder and harder to recreate the old ear-cleaning sound,

like it was some kind of sacred ritual for the video 😂

IT HAPPENED.
The old sound came back.
While scratching with the metal ear pick in the recording,
I literally almost cried… because I was so happy LOL

I just wanted to scratch all day.

Okay okay, that was way too long 😂
Now the main point!

I finally did the ear-cleaning video again,
and there’s something I really recommend you listen for.

There are three types of wooden ear picks in the video:

Wooden ear pick #1 — Very rough

Wooden ear pick #2 — Medium rough ★

Wooden ear pick #3 — Less rough ★

Please listen to #2 and #3 especially!!!!!!!!

And also the metal ear pick AND finger ear-cleaning are MUST-LISTENS!!!!! ★★★★★
Five stars LMAO

I think in December I’m going to go FULL ear-cleaning mode and just dig into ear-picks only 😂
My “December happiness project.” I really want to do it.

Good night everyone :) 🌙

세번째꺼는 귓속 검정색 스티커가 얇아서 고막이 많이보이는 상태?
첫번째랑 많이 달랐어요 
그래서 소리가 점점 옛날같지가 않았던 거에요 
ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ

귀청소 컨텐츠는 자연스레 인기가 줄게 되었어요

그 뒤로 편집으로 애를 썼지만

근데 알죠 여러분?

너무 좋아하는데 못하니까 아주 답답하더라고요

괜히 옷도 5~6년전 옷 꺼내입고 경건하게 영상찍고 있는데

헐.. 옛날 그 소리가 나는거에요
실제로 영상에서 쇠귀이개 긁다가 눈물날뻔했어요
행복해서 ㅋㅋㅋ

하루종일 긁고 싶더라구요!!

---------------------

아 그래서 귀청소를 했는데
꼭 들어보시라고 추천하고 싶은게 있어요!

1번 나무귀이개 - 매우거침

12월의 행복, 꼭 해보고 싶어요

잘자요 여러분 :)

Finally… the old sound is BACK 😭😭 (and I randomly ended up wearing a 5-year-old outfit too LOL)

So, I had a little personal struggle for a long time.
I really missed the sound of the very first white 3Dio mic I bought 7 years ago.

I actually re-purchased the white 3Dio… I think three times?
(They all broke because I treated them pretty roughly, so I kept buying new ones…)

But no matter what I bought,
none of them sounded as good as the very first one.
And honestly… that became a low-key stress for me 😭

The second one had that annoying bzzzz noise whenever the ear pick touched it.
The third one had the inner black sticker so thin that the eardrum area was too exposed(?)
It sounded really different from the first mic.
So the sound kept drifting away from the “old” classic sound…
😭😭😭

People who are sensitive to sound had already noticed it,
and my ear-cleaning videos naturally became a bit less popular.

I tried my best in editing afterwards,
but it became harder and harder to recreate the old ear-cleaning sound,
so I ended up doing less of those videos too…

But you know this already, right?
I’m an ear-cleaning maniac.
I LOVE ear cleaning ASMR.
Not being able to do it the way I wanted was torture 😭

So this time I said, “Let’s buy another one and try again!”
And I did!!
And I even put on an outfit from 5–6 years ago for no reason,
like it was some kind of sacred ritual for the video 😂

And then—
IT HAPPENED.
The old sound came back.
While scratching with the metal ear pick in the recording,
I literally almost cried… because I was so happy LOL

I just wanted to scratch all day.

Okay okay, that was way too long 😂
Now the main point!

I finally did the ear-cleaning video again,
and there’s something I really recommend you listen for.

There are three types of wooden ear picks in the video:

Wooden ear pick #1 — Very rough

Wooden ear pick #2 — Medium rough ★

Wooden ear pick #3 — Less rough ★

Please listen to #2 and #3 especially!!!!!!!!

And also the metal ear pick AND finger ear-cleaning are MUST-LISTENS!!!!! ★★★★★
Five stars LMAO

I think in December I’m going to go FULL ear-cleaning mode and just dig into ear-picks only 😂
My “December happiness project.” I really want to do it.

Good night everyone :) 🌙

너무 좋아하는데 못하니까 아주 답답하더라고요

괜히 옷도 5~6년전 옷 꺼내입고 경건하게 영상찍고 있는데

실제로 영상에서 쇠귀이개 긁다가 눈물날뻔했어요
행복해서 ㅋㅋㅋ

하루종일 긁고 싶더라구요!!

---------------------

12월의 행복, 꼭 해보고 싶어요

잘자요 여러분 :)

So, I had a little personal struggle for a long time.
I really missed the sound of the very first white 3Dio mic I bought 7 years ago.

I actually re-purchased the white 3Dio… I think three times?
(They all broke because I treated them pretty roughly, so I kept buying new ones…)

But no matter what I bought,
none of them sounded as good as the very first one.
And honestly… that became a low-key stress for me 😭

The second one had that annoying bzzzz noise whenever the ear pick touched it.
The third one had the inner black sticker so thin that the eardrum area was too exposed(?)
It sounded really different from the first mic.
So the sound kept drifting away from the “old” classic sound…
😭😭😭

People who are sensitive to sound had already noticed it,
and my ear-cleaning videos naturally became a bit less popular.

I tried my best in editing afterwards,
but it became harder and harder to recreate the old ear-cleaning sound,
so I ended up doing less of those videos too…

But you know this already, right?
I’m an ear-cleaning maniac.
I LOVE ear cleaning ASMR.
Not being able to do it the way I wanted was torture 😭

So this time I said, “Let’s buy another one and try again!”
And I did!!
And I even put on an outfit from 5–6 years ago for no reason,
like it was some kind of sacred ritual for the video 😂

And then—
IT HAPPENED.
The old sound came back.
While scratching with the metal ear pick in the recording,
I literally almost cried… because I was so happy LOL

I just wanted to scratch all day.

Okay okay, that was way too long 😂
Now the main point!

I finally did the ear-cleaning video again,
and there’s something I really recommend you listen for.

There are three types of wooden ear picks in the video:

Wooden ear pick #1 — Very rough

Wooden ear pick #2 — Medium rough ★

Wooden ear pick #3 — Less rough ★

Please listen to #2 and #3 especially!!!!!!!!

And also the metal ear pick AND finger ear-cleaning are MUST-LISTENS!!!!! ★★★★★
Five stars LMAO

I think in December I’m going to go FULL ear-cleaning mode and just dig into ear-picks only 😂
My “December happiness project.” I really want to do it.

Good night everyone :) 🌙

de-AT.title: ASMR 👂 Neuer 3Dio Ohrreinigungs-Test 🔥 Der klassische Sound ist zurück ✨ (Deutsche UT)
de-AT.description:
#ASMR #asmrearcleaning #asmr귀청소

드디어 ㅠㅠ옛날 소리가 복귀!! (옷도 마침 5년전 옷 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ)
저 사실, 저만의 고충이 있었습니다. 
처음에 샀던 그 흰색3Dio 마이크소리가 너무 그리웠어요
저는 지금까지 흰색 3dio를 3개인가를 재구매 했었는데요
(험하게 다뤄서 전부 고장 이슈로 다시사곤 했습니다 )

그런데 ,
처음에 샀던 3dio 만한 소리가 안나는거예요
매번 그게 저의 은근한 스트레스였어요 ㅠㅠ

두번째 샀던건 귀이개가 닿으면 웅웅 거리는 이슈가
세번째꺼는 귓속 검정색 스티커가 얇아서 고막이 많이보이는 상태?
첫번째랑 많이 달랐어요 
그래서 소리가 점점 옛날같지가 않았던 거에요 
ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ

소리에 민감하신분들은 벌써 눈치채시고
귀청소 컨텐츠는 자연스레 인기가 줄게 되었어요

그 뒤로 편집으로 애를 썼지만
옛날만큼 귀청소 소리 내기가 어려워져서
좀 컨텐츠가 적어진 것도 있었어요......

근데 알죠 여러분?
저 귀청소 광인거 ㅠ
너무 좋아하는데 못하니까 아주 답답하더라고요

이번에 다시 사보자! 싶어서 샀는데!!!
괜히 옷도 5~6년전 옷 꺼내입고 경건하게 영상찍고 있는데

헐.. 옛날 그 소리가 나는거에요
실제로 영상에서 쇠귀이개 긁다가 눈물날뻔했어요
행복해서 ㅋㅋㅋ

하루종일 긁고 싶더라구요!!

---------------------
너무 길었죠? ㅎㅎ이제 본론!
아 그래서 귀청소를 했는데
꼭 들어보시라고 추천하고 싶은게 있어요!

나무귀이개 3종류가 나오는데요

1번 나무귀이개 - 매우거침
2번 나무귀이개 - 중간거침★
3번 나무귀이개 - 덜거침★

2번 3번 을 꼭 들어주세요!!!!!!!!

그리고 쇠귀이개랑 손가락귀청소 꼭!!!!★★★★★
별 5개!! ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ

저 이거 12월에 귀이개 한우물만 파서 해볼려구요ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
12월의 행복, 꼭 해보고 싶어요

잘자요 여러분 :)

Finally… the old sound is BACK 😭😭 (and I randomly ended up wearing a 5-year-old outfit too LOL)

So, I had a little personal struggle for a long time.
I really missed the sound of the very first white 3Dio mic I bought 7 years ago.

I actually re-purchased the white 3Dio… I think three times?
(They all broke because I treated them pretty roughly, so I kept buying new ones…)

But no matter what I bought,
none of them sounded as good as the very first one.
And honestly… that became a low-key stress for me 😭

The second one had that annoying bzzzz noise whenever the ear pick touched it.
The third one had the inner black sticker so thin that the eardrum area was too exposed(?)
It sounded really different from the first mic.
So the sound kept drifting away from the “old” classic sound…
😭😭😭

People who are sensitive to sound had already noticed it,
and my ear-cleaning videos naturally became a bit less popular.

I tried my best in editing afterwards,
but it became harder and harder to recreate the old ear-cleaning sound,
so I ended up doing less of those videos too…

But you know this already, right?
I’m an ear-cleaning maniac.
I LOVE ear cleaning ASMR.
Not being able to do it the way I wanted was torture 😭

So this time I said, “Let’s buy another one and try again!”
And I did!!
And I even put on an outfit from 5–6 years ago for no reason,
like it was some kind of sacred ritual for the video 😂

And then—
IT HAPPENED.
The old sound came back.
While scratching with the metal ear pick in the recording,
I literally almost cried… because I was so happy LOL

I just wanted to scratch all day.

Okay okay, that was way too long 😂
Now the main point!

I finally did the ear-cleaning video again,
and there’s something I really recommend you listen for.

There are three types of wooden ear picks in the video:

Wooden ear pick #1 — Very rough

Wooden ear pick #2 — Medium rough ★

Wooden ear pick #3 — Less rough ★

Please listen to #2 and #3 especially!!!!!!!!

And also the metal ear pick AND finger ear-cleaning are MUST-LISTENS!!!!! ★★★★★
Five stars LMAO

I think in December I’m going to go FULL ear-cleaning mode and just dig into ear-picks only 😂
My “December happiness project.” I really want to do it.

Good night everyone :) 🌙

snippet.title: ASMR 시각적 팅글의 기본은 브러쉬부터 시작된다
snippet.description:
#asmr #asmrpersonalatttention #asmrbrushing

안녕하세요! 여러가지 브러쉬들 소리들은 비밀이 감춰져 있답니다
바로바로!
후시녹음이 전부 다 다른 마이크라는 것!

고인물 께서는
눈을 감고 어떤 마이크인지
맞춰봐도 좋구요
(윗쪽에 답이 적혀있으니 답을 가리고 해보세요!)

눈을 뜨고 은근한 차이가 있는 소리들을 구별해 보셔도
좋습니다

그리고, 브러쉬 뒷면으로 뾰족한 부분으로
카메라 렌즈를 톡톡 건드는 팅글도 있어요!
브러쉬 마다 뒷모양과 두께가 조금씩 다른데요!
그 차이를 느껴보세요

그리고 가끔 수다를 떠는데요!
3dio pro2 마이크를 들고 초근접으로 말소리를 녹음했어요!!

오늘 밤
눈이 감기는 시각적 팅글을 마음껏 누리시길 바랍니당!!
반나잇~~

Hello everyone! ✨
Each of these brush sounds hides a little secret…
Can you guess what it is?

That’s right — every sound was re-recorded with a different microphone! 🎙️

For ASMR pros out there,
try closing your eyes and guessing which mic is which.
(Answers are written above, so cover them first!)

Or, keep your eyes open and notice
the subtle differences in each sound — that’s fun too!

There’s also a special tingling sound
from the pointed back of the brush tapping on the camera lens📸
Each brush has a slightly different shape and thickness —
see if you can feel the difference.

Tonight,
let your eyes slowly close and enjoy the visual tingles to your heart’s content.
Good night, 🌙💤

こんにちは〜！✨
いろいろなブラシの音には、実は小さな秘密が隠れているんです。
その秘密とは……

なんと！すべての音が違うマイクで後録りされていること！🎙️

ASMR上級者の皆さんは、
目を閉じてどのマイクか当ててみても面白いですよ。
（上の答えを隠してから挑戦してみてください！）

目を開けたまま、
それぞれの音の微妙な違いを感じ取るのもおすすめです。

そして今回は、ブラシの後ろのとがった部分で
カメラのレンズをトントンする音📸も入っています！
ブラシごとに形や太さが少しずつ違うので、
その差も感じてみてくださいね。

今夜は、
目がとろ〜んと閉じるような視覚的ティングルを
たっぷり楽しんでください。
おやすみなさい、ハーフナイト〜🌙💤

snippet.title: ASMR 지금 막 산 새제품 뜯어서💖친구 메이크업 해주기💄🎁(박스소리 팅글,속닥속닥,올리브영템) | Doing your Make up (Friend)
snippet.description:
#asmr #asmrmakeup #asmr메이크업

안녕하세요! 오랜만에 메이크업 상황극 입니다!!
실제로 올리브영가서 제품 고민고민하며 사왔어요 ㅋㅋㅋ(광고아니고 진짜..)
오늘 대사에 1시간동안 골랐다는 대사가 있는데
그게 실제를 반영한 대사랍니다 ㅋㅋㅋ

예전에 1인칭 피부샵때도 그렇고
새제품 박스부터 뜯는 그게 소리가 그렇게 좋더라구요
그래서 박스부터 뜯는 메이크업을 해야겠다 생각을 했네요

새로산 화장품은 늘 설레지 않습니까?
약간 그런느낌이 가득 담겨있어요!!
ㅎㅎ
표정이 안나와서 아쉽지만
실제로 박스들을 처음 뜯으면서 설렜답니다 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

예상보다 박스소리가 마이크가 덜가까워서
엄청난 팅글이 돋지 못한게 살짝 아쉬워서
나중엔 1인칭으로 한번더 해봐야겠다 생각했어요

그래도 잔잔한 팅글들과 후시녹음의 팅글들이 있으니까요!!
이제 10월이네요 여러분
곧 추석이기도 하구요 ㅎㅎ

추석때 맛있는거 많이 드시고
좋은날들 보내세요!! 
반나잇

00:59 상황극 시작 RP START

Subtitles coming in a few days!
Hi everyone! It’s been a while since the last makeup roleplay! 💄
I actually went to Olive Young and spent so much time choosing the products, haha.
There’s even a line in today’s script that says I spent an hour picking them —
and yes, that’s 100% true! 😂

Just like my old “1st-person skincare ASMR,”
the sound of opening brand-new boxes is so satisfying,
so I thought, why not do a makeup video starting right from the unboxing? 🎁

New cosmetics always give that little spark of excitement, don’t they? ✨
That cozy, heart-fluttering vibe is packed into this video!
Even though you can’t see my facial expressions this time,
I really did feel that excitement while unboxing everything, haha.

The only thing is — the mic wasn’t super close,
so the box-tapping tingles aren’t as strong as I hoped 😅
Next time, I’ll definitely try a 1st-person version again!

Still, there are plenty of soft tingles and post-recorded sounds to enjoy. 💕
It’s already October, everyone — getting chilly, right?
Stay warm, and as always, I love you all. 🫶

字幕は数日後に追加されます！
みなさん、こんにちは！✨
久しぶりのメイクロールプレイです💄
実はオリーブヤングに行って、どのコスメを買うか1時間くらい悩みました(笑)
今日のセリフにも「1時間も 고민した」って出てくるんですが、
それ、本当なんです😂

前にやった「一人称スキンケアASMR」の時もそうだったんですけど、
新品の箱を開ける“あの音”って、すごく気持ちいいんですよね🎁
だから今回は「箱を開けるところから始まるメイクASMR」を撮ってみました！

新しいコスメって、なんかワクワクしませんか？💖
そんなときめきをいっぱい詰め込みました✨
表情が見えないのがちょっと残念だけど、
実際に箱を開けながらドキドキしてました(笑)

マイクが少し遠くて、思ったより強いティングルは出なかったけど、
次は一人称バージョンでまた撮ってみたいと思います🎧

でも今回は、やさしいティングル音と後録りの音もたくさん入ってます！💫
もう10月ですね🍁 寒くなってきたので、
みなさんあたたかくして過ごしてくださいね。
いつもありがとうございます。大好きです💗

Hi everyone! It’s been a while since the last makeup roleplay! 💄

There’s even a line in today’s script that says I spent an hour picking them —
and yes, that’s 100% true! 😂

Just like my old “1st-person skincare ASMR,”
the sound of opening brand-new boxes is so satisfying,
so I thought, why not do a makeup video starting right from the unboxing? 🎁

That cozy, heart-fluttering vibe is packed into this video!
Even though you can’t see my facial expressions this time,
I really did feel that excitement while unboxing everything, haha.

The only thing is — the mic wasn’t super close,
so the box-tapping tingles aren’t as strong as I hoped 😅
Next time, I’ll definitely try a 1st-person version again!

Still, there are plenty of soft tingles and post-recorded sounds to enjoy. 💕
It’s already October, everyone — getting chilly, right?
Stay warm, and as always, I love you all. 🫶

실제로 올리브영가서 제품 고민고민하며 사왔어요 ㅋㅋㅋ
오늘 대사에 1시간동안 골랐다는 대사가 있는데

약간 그런느낌이 가득 담겨있어요!!
ㅎㅎ
표정이 안나와서 아쉽지만
실제로 박스들을 처음 뜯으면서 설렜답니다 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

Stay warm, and as always, I love you all. 🫶

처음에 볼륨조절을 낮게해주세요!

모두들 반나잇 !!

Hello! This is Ban Bo-young.
The original recording was over 40 minutes long, but after cutting out all the rambling parts, the final video ended up much shorter, haha.

Since I was chatting super up-close, please lower the volume at the beginning!

At some point, I suddenly start doing ear blowing, and I found that this mic works really well for that, haha.

Unlike Rode mics that tend to compress the sound thinly, these mics on both sides give a fuller range of tones, so you’ll probably feel a stronger brain-tingle effect. hehe.

The next video will be a roleplay skit.

Good night, everyone!! 🌙✨

最初は40分以上もあったんですが、あちこち話が飛んでいたので編集したら、かなり短くなっちゃいました。笑

かなり近くで本気のおしゃべりをしているので、最初は音量を少し下げてくださいね！

途中で突然イヤーブローイングをするんですが、このマイクでやるとすごく良い感じなんですよね…笑

오늘 미리보기가 알차고 할말다썼으니 꼭 보고 가세요!! 
반나잇 :)

Hi everyone, it’s Boyoung ASMR!
Today we’re back with a first-person skincare salon roleplay—it’s been a while, right?
But this isn’t your regular skincare salon… it’s a little unusual.
We’re doing pore care with slime!

Of course, since it’s still a “salon,” I’ll also be applying some ampoules and cream along the way.

So why did I make this? ㅋㅋ
You know how slime is all stretchy and sticky?
I imagined, “If this sticks to the skin, it could pull out all the sebum!”
That silly thought became today’s content.

This slime has amazing suction power for pores.
And when I poke little holes in it and fill them with pretty ingredients,
it actually gives an even more tingly and satisfying vibe visually!

By the end of today’s session, your pores will be squeaky clean—
not a single trace of sebum left, haha.

Of course, it’s totally nonsense,
but as always, I love these ridiculous little fantasies,
so let’s dive into some serious nonsense again today.

I’ve already spoiled half the fun in this preview, so make sure you watch the whole thing!
Good night, everyone :)

안녕하세요. 반보영 입니다
의사 상황극 ASMR 은 오랜만이에요!
따끔주사라고 몇년전에 제가 엄청나게 좋아했던 소리가 있는데요!

갑자기 립글로스가 귀보호제가 되는 마법..

ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기
가 있답니다ㅋㅋ
귀마사지 소리는 보호제를 바른후에 장갑도 낀채로 하는거라
쫀뜩쫀득!! 거려서 좋았어요

검정마이크만의 
쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!
깔짝깔짝 간질거려요
공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

반나잇 !!

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

耳マッサージの音は、保護ジェルを塗ったあとに手袋をして行うので、
もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

耳マッサージの音は、保護ジェルを塗ったあとに手袋をして行うので、
もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

의사 상황극 ASMR 은 오랜만이에요!
따끔주사라고 몇년전에 제가 엄청나게 좋아했던 소리가 있는데요!
얇은주사기랑 왕주사기 소리가 좋아서 오랜만에 팅글왔네요

립틴트가 빨간약이 되는거라던가..
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기
가 있답니다ㅋㅋ
귀마사지 소리는 보호제를 바른후에 장갑도 낀채로 하는거라
쫀뜩쫀득!! 거려서 좋았어요

검정마이크만의 
쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!
깔짝깔짝 간질거려요
공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

반나잇 !!

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

耳マッサージの音は、保護ジェルを塗ったあとに手袋をして行うので、
もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

耳マッサージの音は、保護ジェルを塗ったあとに手袋をして行うので、
もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

의사 상황극 ASMR 은 오랜만이에요!
따끔주사라고 몇년전에 제가 엄청나게 좋아했던 소리가 있는데요!
얇은주사기랑 왕주사기 소리가 좋아서 오랜만에 팅글왔네요
스펀지를 귀에 대고 맞는건데요
3가지 스펀지가 있어서 듣는맛이 있으실 거에요

냉혈한데 어딘가 따뜻한 성격의 의사에요
아
오늘도 약간 헛소리 있어요
갑자기 립글로스가 귀보호제가 되는 마법..
립틴트가 빨간약이 되는거라던가..
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기
가 있답니다ㅋㅋ
귀마사지 소리는 보호제를 바른후에 장갑도 낀채로 하는거라
쫀뜩쫀득!! 거려서 좋았어요

검정마이크만의 
쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!
깔짝깔짝 간질거려요
공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

반나잇 !!

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

耳マッサージの音は、保護ジェルを塗ったあとに手袋をして行うので、
もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기

쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!
깔짝깔짝 간질거려요
공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

반나잇 !!

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

耳マッサージの音は、保護ジェルを塗ったあとに手袋をして行うので、
もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기

쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!

공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）

突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

cs.description:
