의사 상황극 ASMR 은 오랜만이에요!
따끔주사라고 몇년전에 제가 엄청나게 좋아했던 소리가 있는데요!
얇은주사기랑 왕주사기 소리가 좋아서 오랜만에 팅글왔네요
스펀지를 귀에 대고 맞는건데요
3가지 스펀지가 있어서 듣는맛이 있으실 거에요

냉혈한데 어딘가 따뜻한 성격의 의사에요
아
오늘도 약간 헛소리 있어요
갑자기 립글로스가 귀보호제가 되는 마법..
립틴트가 빨간약이 되는거라던가..
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기
가 있답니다ㅋㅋ
귀마사지 소리는 보호제를 바른후에 장갑도 낀채로 하는거라
쫀뜩쫀득!! 거려서 좋았어요

검정마이크만의 
쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!
깔짝깔짝 간질거려요
공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

반나잇 !!

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ

もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

립틴트가 빨간약이 되는거라던가..
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기

귀마사지 소리는 보호제를 바른후에 장갑도 낀채로 하는거라

검정마이크만의 
쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!
깔짝깔짝 간질거려요
공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、

– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

#asmr #asmrdoctor #asmr의사

안녕하세요. 반보영 입니다
의사 상황극 ASMR 은 오랜만이에요!
따끔주사라고 몇년전에 제가 엄청나게 좋아했던 소리가 있는데요!
얇은주사기랑 왕주사기 소리가 좋아서 오랜만에 팅글왔네요
스펀지를 귀에 대고 맞는건데요
3가지 스펀지가 있어서 듣는맛이 있으실 거에요

냉혈한데 어딘가 따뜻한 성격의 의사에요
아
오늘도 약간 헛소리 있어요
갑자기 립글로스가 귀보호제가 되는 마법..
립틴트가 빨간약이 되는거라던가..
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기
가 있답니다ㅋㅋ
귀마사지 소리는 보호제를 바른후에 장갑도 낀채로 하는거라
쫀뜩쫀득!! 거려서 좋았어요

검정마이크만의 
쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!
깔짝깔짝 간질거려요
공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

반나잇 !!

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

耳マッサージの音は、保護ジェルを塗ったあとに手袋をして行うので、
もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

*[TIMELINE]*
00:00 미리보기 [Preview]
03:40 상황극 시작 [Roleplay begins]
05:00 귀에 불빛 비춰보면서 진단하기 [Ear check with flashlight]
09:58 멸균장갑 끼는 소리 [Putting on sterile gloves sounds]
12:50 귀소독 [Ear disinfection]
18:48 귀보호제 바르기 (립글로스임) [Applying ear protection gel (it's actually lip gloss 😆)]

---------[귀마사지] [Ear Massage]-------
23:28 장갑끼고 귀마사지  [Gloved ear massage]★★★★★


---------[따끔주사] [Tingly Injections]-------
27:15 뒷배경에서 주사기 꺼내오기 [Taking out syringe in the background]

28:16 물결스펀지 + 얇은주사기 [Wavy sponge + Thin syringe]★★
32:43 (귀 보이는 구도) [(Ear visible angle)]
33:56 물결스펀지 + 왕주사기 [Wavy sponge + Giant syringe]★★★★★
42:34 (귀 보이는 구도) [(Ear visible angle)]

47:26 밀도스펀지 + 얇은주사기 [Dense sponge + Thin syringe]★★★
50:09 (귀 보이는 구도) [(Ear visible angle)]
52:34 밀도스펀지 + 왕주사기  [Dense sponge + Giant syringe ]★★
55:22 (귀 보이는 구도) [(Ear visible angle)]

57:41 초록스펀지 + 얇은주사기 [Green sponge + Thin syringe]
01:00:13 (귀 보이는 구도) [(Ear visible angle)]
01:03:12 초록스펀지 + 왕주사기 [Green sponge + Giant syringe]
01:04:33 (귀 보이는 구도) [(Ear visible angle)]


-------[귀청소] [Ear Cleaning]-------
01:05:33 솜털 귀청소 [Fluffy cotton ear cleaning]
01:08:18 나무귀이개 [Wooden ear pick]★
01:11:18 쇠귀이개 [Metal ear pick ]★★
01:14:12 솜털 귀청소 [Fluffy cotton ear cleaning]
01:15:01 공주브러쉬 [Princess brush ]★★

01:16:34 빨간약 바르기 (립틴트임 ㅋㅋ) [Applying red medicine (it’s actually lip tint lol)]
01:17:40 귀에 밴드 붙이고 다음 환자 부르는 보영 [Putting a bandage on ear & Bo-young calls the next patient]

-가입시 혜택 : 멤버십영상(NG영상, 후기영상) +추가혜택(년차 쌓일시),모든댓글에 답장

의사 상황극 ASMR 은 오랜만이에요!

립틴트가 빨간약이 되는거라던가..
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기
가 있답니다ㅋㅋ
귀마사지 소리는 보호제를 바른후에 장갑도 낀채로 하는거라

검정마이크만의 
쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!
깔짝깔짝 간질거려요
공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

반나잇 !!

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

耳マッサージの音は、保護ジェルを塗ったあとに手袋をして行うので、
もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.

– Ear disinfection

– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.

– Ear massage

의사 상황극 ASMR 은 오랜만이에요!

립틴트가 빨간약이 되는거라던가..
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

오늘 소리는요!
귀소독, 귀청소, 귀마사지, 귀주사, 귀에 밴드붙이기 , 귀보호제 바르기
가 있답니다ㅋㅋ
귀마사지 소리는 보호제를 바른후에 장갑도 낀채로 하는거라
쫀뜩쫀득!! 거려서 좋았어요

검정마이크만의 
쇠귀이개랑 나무귀이개 소리도 들어보세요!
깔짝깔짝 간질거려요
공주브러쉬도 좋은데 너무 말이 길어지는 것 같아서 이만 써야겠네요

반나잇 !!

Hello! This is Boyoung ASMR.
It’s been a while since I’ve done a doctor roleplay ASMR!

There’s a sound I used to really love a few years ago — the "tingly injection" 💉
I loved the sounds of the thin syringe and the giant syringe so much, and it gave me tingles again after a long time!

This time, I’m pressing sponge tips against your ears.
There are three different kinds of sponges, so you’ll get to enjoy the variety of textures!

I play a cold-hearted doctor… with a secretly warm personality.
Ah, and as always, there’s a bit of nonsense today too 😆
Like suddenly using lip gloss as ear protector…
Or saying lip tint is red medicine… LOL

Here are the sounds featured today!
– Ear disinfection
– Ear cleaning
– Ear massage
– Ear injection
– Applying bandage to your ear
– Putting on ear protection gel

The ear massage part is done with gloves after applying the protection gel,
So it’s all squishy and sticky — super satisfying! 💕

Also, don't miss the exclusive metal and wooden ear picks sounds from the black mic!
They’re scratchy and tickly~

The princess brush is also amazing…
but I think I’m rambling too much, so I’ll stop here 😅

Good night~! 💫

こんにちは、パン・ボヨンです。
お医者さんのロールプレイASMRは久しぶりですね！

何年か前に私がすごくハマってた音、「チクッと注射」💉の音があるんです！
細い注射器と大きな注射器の音がすごく好きで、久しぶりにゾワゾワきちゃいました〜

今回は、スポンジを耳にあてて注射する設定です。
3種類のスポンジを使ってるので、聴き心地の違いも楽しめると思います！

冷たいようで、どこかあたたかい性格のお医者さんです（笑）
あ、今日もちょっと意味不明なこと言ってます😂
突然リップグロスが耳の保護剤になったり、
リップティントが赤チンになったりとか…（笑）

今回の音はですね〜
・耳の消毒
・耳かき
・耳マッサージ
・耳に注射
・耳にバンソウコウを貼る
・耳の保護ジェルを塗る

耳マッサージの音は、保護ジェルを塗ったあとに手袋をして行うので、
もちもち・ねっとりした音がして気持ちよかったです💕

黒マイクだけの特別な音、金属の耳かきと木の耳かきの音もぜひ聴いてみてください！
カリカリ、こそばゆい感じがクセになりますよ〜

あとね、お姫様ブラシの音もいいんだけど、
ちょっと喋りすぎちゃったのでこの辺で（笑）

おやすみなさい〜🌙

snippet.description:
#asmr #asmrhaircut #asmr미용실

반쪽이들이 좋아하는 나무장난감으로 미용실 상황극 OPEN!
오늘의 샴푸실에선 샤워기에서 진짜 물이 나옵니다ㅎㅎ!!(1인칭 샴푸실이라 실감나요!)
이전에 나무메이크업영상 기억나시나요? 거기서 맨끝부분에 나무가위로 잠깐 머리잘라주는씬이 있었는데
그 짧은구간을 많이보신 걸로 통계가 뜨더라구용?!
사실 끝에 쪼금 나오는거라서 못보시고 지나치실거라 생각했는데
약간 감동크리 터졌습니당 ㅎㅎ

그리하여
나무가위로 싹둑싹둑!
근데 또 그냥 자르면 재미없죠!!!!!
이 가위는 엄청난 초능력의 가위!
기억을 다듬어주거나 감정을 잘라내주는 가위!

나무빗은 빗으면 기억을 읽어낸다는 뭐 그런내용.....ㅋㅋ
(상당히 판타지 스럽습니다)

오랜만에 샴푸하는것도 해봤는데요!(1인칭 샴푸)
실제로 샤워기 물뿌려드리고 샴푸도 해봤어요ㅋㅋ

나무고데기도 나와용!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

이전에 나무메이크업영상 기억나시나요? 거기서 맨끝부분에 나무가위로 잠깐 머리잘라주는씬이 있었는데
그 짧은구간을 많이보신 걸로 통계가 뜨더라구용?!
사실 끝에 쪼금 나오는거라서 못보시고 지나치실거라 생각했는데

그리하여
나무가위로 싹둑싹둑!
근데 또 그냥 자르면 재미없죠!!!!!
이 가위는 엄청난 초능력의 가위!
기억을 다듬어주거나 감정을 잘라내주는 가위!

나무빗은 빗으면 기억을 읽어낸다는 뭐 그런내용.....ㅋㅋ
(상당히 판타지 스럽습니다)

오랜만에 샴푸하는것도 해봤는데요!(1인칭 샴푸)
실제로 샤워기 물뿌려드리고 샴푸도 해봤어요ㅋㅋ

나무고데기도 나와용! 

저 요번에 편집하면서 느낀게
헤어컷 부분에서
나무빗과 나무가위가 서로 부딪히는 소리가 
달그락 거리고 아주좋더라구요
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

반쪽이들이 이영상을 
시간이 지나도 가끔씩 왠지모르게 생각났으면 해가지구
약간.. '분홍색 그 영상!!'하면 떠오를수 있게
배경을 아기자기하게 해봤어요 ㅋㅋ


6월이네요
이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

사실 끝에 쪼금 나오는거라서 못보시고 지나치실거라 생각했는데

헤어컷 부분에서
나무빗과 나무가위가 서로 부딪히는 소리가

6월이네요
이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),

the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

6월이네요
이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

반쪽이들이 좋아하는 나무장난감으로 미용실 상황극 OPEN!
오늘의 샴푸실에선 샤워기에서 진짜 물이 나옵니다ㅎㅎ!!(1인칭 샴푸실이라 실감나요!)
이전에 나무메이크업영상 기억나시나요? 거기서 맨끝부분에 나무가위로 잠깐 머리잘라주는씬이 있었는데
그 짧은구간을 많이보신 걸로 통계가 뜨더라구용?!
사실 끝에 쪼금 나오는거라서 못보시고 지나치실거라 생각했는데
약간 감동크리 터졌습니당 ㅎㅎ

그리하여
나무가위로 싹둑싹둑!
근데 또 그냥 자르면 재미없죠!!!!!
이 가위는 엄청난 초능력의 가위!
기억을 다듬어주거나 감정을 잘라내주는 가위!

나무빗은 빗으면 기억을 읽어낸다는 뭐 그런내용.....ㅋㅋ
(상당히 판타지 스럽습니다)

오랜만에 샴푸하는것도 해봤는데요!(1인칭 샴푸)
실제로 샤워기 물뿌려드리고 샴푸도 해봤어요ㅋㅋ

나무고데기도 나와용! 

저 요번에 편집하면서 느낀게
헤어컷 부분에서
나무빗과 나무가위가 서로 부딪히는 소리가 
달그락 거리고 아주좋더라구요
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

반쪽이들이 이영상을 
시간이 지나도 가끔씩 왠지모르게 생각났으면 해가지구
약간.. '분홍색 그 영상!!'하면 떠오를수 있게
배경을 아기자기하게 해봤어요 ㅋㅋ


6월이네요
이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

반쪽이들이 이영상을

이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?

Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂

the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.

you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

오늘의 샴푸실에선 샤워기에서 진짜 물이 나옵니다ㅎㅎ!!(1인칭 샴푸실이라 실감나요!)
이전에 나무메이크업영상 기억나시나요? 거기서 맨끝부분에 나무가위로 잠깐 머리잘라주는씬이 있었는데
그 짧은구간을 많이보신 걸로 통계가 뜨더라구용?!
사실 끝에 쪼금 나오는거라서 못보시고 지나치실거라 생각했는데
약간 감동크리 터졌습니당 ㅎㅎ

그리하여
나무가위로 싹둑싹둑!
근데 또 그냥 자르면 재미없죠!!!!!
이 가위는 엄청난 초능력의 가위!
기억을 다듬어주거나 감정을 잘라내주는 가위!

나무빗은 빗으면 기억을 읽어낸다는 뭐 그런내용.....ㅋㅋ
(상당히 판타지 스럽습니다)

오랜만에 샴푸하는것도 해봤는데요!(1인칭 샴푸)
실제로 샤워기 물뿌려드리고 샴푸도 해봤어요ㅋㅋ

나무고데기도 나와용! 

저 요번에 편집하면서 느낀게
헤어컷 부분에서
나무빗과 나무가위가 서로 부딪히는 소리가 
달그락 거리고 아주좋더라구요
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

반쪽이들이 이영상을 
시간이 지나도 가끔씩 왠지모르게 생각났으면 해가지구
약간.. '분홍색 그 영상!!'하면 떠오를수 있게
배경을 아기자기하게 해봤어요 ㅋㅋ


6월이네요
이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

이전에 나무메이크업영상 기억나시나요? 거기서 맨끝부분에 나무가위로 잠깐 머리잘라주는씬이 있었는데
그 짧은구간을 많이보신 걸로 통계가 뜨더라구용?!
사실 끝에 쪼금 나오는거라서 못보시고 지나치실거라 생각했는데
약간 감동크리 터졌습니당 ㅎㅎ

그리하여
나무가위로 싹둑싹둑!
근데 또 그냥 자르면 재미없죠!!!!!
이 가위는 엄청난 초능력의 가위!
기억을 다듬어주거나 감정을 잘라내주는 가위!

나무빗은 빗으면 기억을 읽어낸다는 뭐 그런내용.....ㅋㅋ
(상당히 판타지 스럽습니다)

오랜만에 샴푸하는것도 해봤는데요!(1인칭 샴푸)
실제로 샤워기 물뿌려드리고 샴푸도 해봤어요ㅋㅋ

나무고데기도 나와용! 

저 요번에 편집하면서 느낀게
헤어컷 부분에서
나무빗과 나무가위가 서로 부딪히는 소리가 
달그락 거리고 아주좋더라구요
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

반쪽이들이 이영상을 
시간이 지나도 가끔씩 왠지모르게 생각났으면 해가지구
약간.. '분홍색 그 영상!!'하면 떠오를수 있게
배경을 아기자기하게 해봤어요 ㅋㅋ


6월이네요
이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

이전에 나무메이크업영상 기억나시나요? 거기서 맨끝부분에 나무가위로 잠깐 머리잘라주는씬이 있었는데
그 짧은구간을 많이보신 걸로 통계가 뜨더라구용?!

약간 감동크리 터졌습니당 ㅎㅎ

그리하여
나무가위로 싹둑싹둑!
근데 또 그냥 자르면 재미없죠!!!!!
이 가위는 엄청난 초능력의 가위!
기억을 다듬어주거나 감정을 잘라내주는 가위!

나무빗은 빗으면 기억을 읽어낸다는 뭐 그런내용.....ㅋㅋ
(상당히 판타지 스럽습니다)

오랜만에 샴푸하는것도 해봤는데요!(1인칭 샴푸)
실제로 샤워기 물뿌려드리고 샴푸도 해봤어요ㅋㅋ

나무고데기도 나와용! 

저 요번에 편집하면서 느낀게
헤어컷 부분에서
나무빗과 나무가위가 서로 부딪히는 소리가 
달그락 거리고 아주좋더라구요
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

반쪽이들이 이영상을 
시간이 지나도 가끔씩 왠지모르게 생각났으면 해가지구
약간.. '분홍색 그 영상!!'하면 떠오를수 있게
배경을 아기자기하게 해봤어요 ㅋㅋ


6월이네요
이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

이전에 나무메이크업영상 기억나시나요? 거기서 맨끝부분에 나무가위로 잠깐 머리잘라주는씬이 있었는데
그 짧은구간을 많이보신 걸로 통계가 뜨더라구용?!
사실 끝에 쪼금 나오는거라서 못보시고 지나치실거라 생각했는데
약간 감동크리 터졌습니당 ㅎㅎ

그리하여
나무가위로 싹둑싹둑!
근데 또 그냥 자르면 재미없죠!!!!!
이 가위는 엄청난 초능력의 가위!
기억을 다듬어주거나 감정을 잘라내주는 가위!

나무빗은 빗으면 기억을 읽어낸다는 뭐 그런내용.....ㅋㅋ
(상당히 판타지 스럽습니다)

오랜만에 샴푸하는것도 해봤는데요!(1인칭 샴푸)
실제로 샤워기 물뿌려드리고 샴푸도 해봤어요ㅋㅋ

나무고데기도 나와용! 

저 요번에 편집하면서 느낀게
헤어컷 부분에서
나무빗과 나무가위가 서로 부딪히는 소리가 
달그락 거리고 아주좋더라구요
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

반쪽이들이 이영상을 
시간이 지나도 가끔씩 왠지모르게 생각났으면 해가지구
약간.. '분홍색 그 영상!!'하면 떠오를수 있게
배경을 아기자기하게 해봤어요 ㅋㅋ


6월이네요
이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

이전에 나무메이크업영상 기억나시나요? 거기서 맨끝부분에 나무가위로 잠깐 머리잘라주는씬이 있었는데
그 짧은구간을 많이보신 걸로 통계가 뜨더라구용?!

약간 감동크리 터졌습니당 ㅎㅎ

그리하여
나무가위로 싹둑싹둑!
근데 또 그냥 자르면 재미없죠!!!!!
이 가위는 엄청난 초능력의 가위!
기억을 다듬어주거나 감정을 잘라내주는 가위!

나무빗은 빗으면 기억을 읽어낸다는 뭐 그런내용.....ㅋㅋ
(상당히 판타지 스럽습니다)

오랜만에 샴푸하는것도 해봤는데요!(1인칭 샴푸)
실제로 샤워기 물뿌려드리고 샴푸도 해봤어요ㅋㅋ

나무고데기도 나와용! 

저 요번에 편집하면서 느낀게
헤어컷 부분에서
나무빗과 나무가위가 서로 부딪히는 소리가 
달그락 거리고 아주좋더라구요
ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ

반쪽이들이 이영상을 
시간이 지나도 가끔씩 왠지모르게 생각났으면 해가지구
약간.. '분홍색 그 영상!!'하면 떠오를수 있게
배경을 아기자기하게 해봤어요 ㅋㅋ


6월이네요
이제 여름시작
물 많이 드세요!

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—
Well… surprisingly, the stats showed a lot of people rewatched that part!
I honestly thought most of you might’ve missed it since it was right at the end…
But seeing that made my heart melt a little. 🥹💕

So… snip snip with the magical wooden scissors! ✂
But of course—just cutting hair would be too boring, right?

These scissors are no ordinary scissors—they have superpowers.
They can trim your memories and cut away heavy emotions... 🧠✨

And the wooden comb? Well, it’s said to read memories as you brush...
(Yep, we’re diving deep into the fantasy vibes here 😂)

It's been a while since I did a shampoo roleplay (first-person POV too!),
but I sprayed real water with the shower and did an actual shampoo session this time! 💦🫧

Oh—and yes, the wooden flat iron makes an appearance too! 😍

While editing, I noticed something really satisfying—
the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.
Honestly... so relaxing 😌💕

I made the background extra cozy and pink this time,
so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

Our little ones' favorite wooden toys are back—this time for a hair salon roleplay! 💇‍♀️✂
And guess what? Today's shampoo room comes with real running water from the shower head! (It’s in first-person POV, so it feels super real 😄)

Do you remember the wooden makeup ASMR video?
There was a short scene at the very end where I used wooden scissors to cut hair for a moment—

the soft clacking sounds when the wooden comb and scissors tap together during the haircut.

so hopefully one day, even long after watching,
you’ll randomly think—“Ah! That pink video!” 🌸

Can you believe it’s already June?
Summer is starting—don’t forget to drink lots of water! 💧

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

こんにちは！不眠に優しい ボヨンのヘアサロン です😊
何年も前から「ヘアブラシの音を一日中流してほしい！」というコメントをたくさんいただいてきました。
これまでは美容室のロールプレイで短く使うだけでしたが、
こうして9種類のヘアブラシをしっかり使った動画は、これが初めてです！

9種類もあるので、音のバリエーションもすごいですよね？うれしい～！

私のブラッシング音はちょっと厚みがあって、重みのある音が特徴です（うまく説明できないけど笑）
でも、それを好んでくださる方が多くて、今回の制作に至りました！

検索ワードに「boyoung hair notalking」ってあったのも見て、
ノートーキングバージョンはなかったな…と思って、今回作ることにしました😂

ついに、眠るときにぴったりなノートーキングASMRが完成です！
しかも1時間以上あるから、寝落ちにもぴったり♪

ブラシを見ているだけでもビジュアル・ティングルがくるかも？
太めのブラシから細いブラシの順で進んでいき、
最後には頭皮マッサージもありますよ！

私は太いブラシの音が好きなんですが、
皆さんはどんな音が一番好きでしたか？

ぜひコメントで教えてくださいね！
おやすみなさい〜 ボヨナイト 🌙💤

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

こうして9種類のヘアブラシをしっかり使った動画は、これが初めてです！

太めのブラシから細いブラシの順で進んでいき、

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

こんにちは！不眠に優しい ボヨンのヘアサロン です😊

太めのブラシから細いブラシの順で進んでいき、

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

ja.title: ASMR ボヨンのスリープサロン 🌙 9種類のコームでヘアブラッシング＆頭皮マッサージで眠りへ [無言]
ja.description:
#asmr #asmrhairbrushing #asmrscalpmassage

안녕하세요! 불면증에 좋은 반보영 헤어살롱 입니다 ㅎㅎ
수년간 댓글로 "헤어브러쉬 소리 하루종일 해주세요" 를 요청받았었는데요
그간 미용실 상황극으로 짧게짧게는 했었는데
이렇게 각잡고 9가지 헤어브러쉬를 한적은 처음이에요!

9가지니까 소리가 엄청 다양하겠죠?!!뿌듯!

제 헤어소리만의 특징은
조금 두툼?하고 무거운 소리가 나는데요(표현을 못하겠네요 ㅋㅋㅋ)
이걸 좋아해주시는 분들이 많으셔서 제작하게 되었어요!
또 연관검색어에 'boyoung hair notalking' 이런것도 있었는데 노토킹이 없던지라.. 해야겠다 생각한 것도 있어요
ㅋㅋㅋ

이제야 잠잘때 틀어놓고 들을만한 노토킹을!!! 
길이도 1시간이 넘으니까 딱이죠?

빗을 쳐다보고있으면 시각적팅글도 꽤나 있을거에요 
두꺼운빗들부터 가느다란빗들 순서로 이어집니다
가장 뒷부분에는 두피마사지도 있어요!

저는 두꺼운 빗들 소리를 좋아하는 편인데
여러분들은 어떤 소리가 좋으셨어요?

댓글에 꼭 적어주면 좋겠어요!! 
반나잇 :)

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

こんにちは！不眠に優しい ボヨンのヘアサロン です😊
何年も前から「ヘアブラシの音を一日中流してほしい！」というコメントをたくさんいただいてきました。
これまでは美容室のロールプレイで短く使うだけでしたが、
こうして9種類のヘアブラシをしっかり使った動画は、これが初めてです！

9種類もあるので、音のバリエーションもすごいですよね？うれしい～！

私のブラッシング音はちょっと厚みがあって、重みのある音が特徴です（うまく説明できないけど笑）
でも、それを好んでくださる方が多くて、今回の制作に至りました！

検索ワードに「boyoung hair notalking」ってあったのも見て、
ノートーキングバージョンはなかったな…と思って、今回作ることにしました😂

ついに、眠るときにぴったりなノートーキングASMRが完成です！
しかも1時間以上あるから、寝落ちにもぴったり♪

ブラシを見ているだけでもビジュアル・ティングルがくるかも？
太めのブラシから細いブラシの順で進んでいき、
最後には頭皮マッサージもありますよ！

私は太いブラシの音が好きなんですが、
皆さんはどんな音が一番好きでしたか？

ぜひコメントで教えてくださいね！
おやすみなさい〜 ボヨナイト 🌙💤

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

こうして9種類のヘアブラシをしっかり使った動画は、これが初めてです！

太めのブラシから細いブラシの順で進んでいき、
最後には頭皮マッサージもありますよ！

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”

but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

太めのブラシから細いブラシの順で進んでいき、

Hello! This is Boyoung’s Hair Salon, perfect for easing your insomnia. 😊
For years, people have commented saying, “Please make hair brushing sounds all day long!”
Up until now, I’ve only included short brushing scenes in hair salon roleplays,
but this is the first time I’ve created a full video featuring 9 different hairbrushes!

Since there are 9 brushes, the sound variety is amazing, right?! So satisfying!

My hair sounds tend to be a bit thick and heavy—I’m not sure how to explain it exactly 😆
But many people seem to enjoy that unique sound,
so I finally decided to make this video!

Also, I noticed people searching for things like “boyoung hair notalking,”
but I hadn’t made a no-talking version before… so I knew I had to do it! 😂

Finally—here is a no-talking video you can fall asleep to.
And it’s over an hour long, so it’s perfect for bedtime!

Watching the brushes may even give you visual tingles.
I arranged them from thicker brushes to finer ones,
and at the end, there’s even a relaxing scalp massage!

Personally, I love the sound of the thicker brushes,
but what kind of sound did you like the most?

Please let me know in the comments!
Sleep well, from Ban-night 🌙💤

こんにちは！不眠に優しい ボヨンのヘアサロン です😊
何年も前から「ヘアブラシの音を一日中流してほしい！」というコメントをたくさんいただいてきました。

こうして9種類のヘアブラシをしっかり使った動画は、これが初めてです！

でも、それを好んでくださる方が多くて、今回の制作に至りました！

検索ワードに「boyoung hair notalking」ってあったのも見て、
ノートーキングバージョンはなかったな…と思って、今回作ることにしました😂

太めのブラシから細いブラシの順で進んでいき、
最後には頭皮マッサージもありますよ！

私は太いブラシの音が好きなんですが、
皆さんはどんな音が一番好きでしたか？

ぜひコメントで教えてくださいね！
おやすみなさい〜 ボヨナイト 🌙💤

쇼핑태그 걸어놓을테니 관심있으신 분들은 눌러봐주세요!

그게 은근히 좋아요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ!!
(미리보기에도 있어요)

*[키보드 정보]*
키보드 이름: evo80 키보드
축: azure축 ( 연블루축 이라고도함)
보강판: fr4

Hello there!
Today’s video is a keyboard typing ASMR where you can see the keyboard and the notepad onscreen at the same time. ㅋㅋㅋ!?

I figured… if I’m not going to talk, at least it should be fun to watch—so I opened up a notepad. 😆

In the later part of the video, I removed the notepad so you can fully focus on the keyboard sounds (It’s super sleep-inducing… Zzz)

This is a brand new keyboard I just bought,
and it sounds like pebbles rolling around.
Or maybe... bubbling stew? 🍲💭

Honestly…
I watched sooo many YouTube videos before deciding which keyboard to get 😂
I was super torn, but the moment I opened the box and felt the keystrokes, I was like:
“Wait… how does it sound this good??” 😭✨
It really felt special. I just know I’ll be using this one for a long time.

I paid about 190,000 won (around $140 USD),
but I’m not sure what the current price is.
I’ll leave a shopping tag—click it if you’re curious!

And yes… I still have more to say ㅎㅎㅎㅎ

This time I tried switching up the camera angles
so your eyes won’t get bored while watching 🫶
You’ll see 3 shots: from the side, the front, and some close-ups of the keyboard!

Also—after the notepad section,
there’s a part where I just go wild on the keys like a piano.
Even smashing them with my palms lol 😂
It’s oddly satisfying. (You’ll catch a preview of it too!)

Sweet dreams & half-night to you :) 🌙✨

Hello there!
Today’s video is a keyboard typing ASMR where you can see the keyboard and the notepad onscreen at the same time. ㅋㅋㅋ!?

I figured… if I’m not going to talk, at least it should be fun to watch—so I opened up a notepad. 😆

In the later part of the video, I removed the notepad so you can fully focus on the keyboard sounds (It’s super sleep-inducing… Zzz)

This is a brand new keyboard I just bought,
and it sounds like pebbles rolling around.
Or maybe... bubbling stew? 🍲💭

Honestly…
I watched sooo many YouTube videos before deciding which keyboard to get 😂
I was super torn, but the moment I opened the box and felt the keystrokes, I was like:
“Wait… how does it sound this good??” 😭✨
It really felt special. I just know I’ll be using this one for a long time.

I paid about 190,000 won (around $140 USD),
but I’m not sure what the current price is.
I’ll leave a shopping tag—click it if you’re curious!

And yes… I still have more to say ㅎㅎㅎㅎ

This time I tried switching up the camera angles
so your eyes won’t get bored while watching 🫶
You’ll see 3 shots: from the side, the front, and some close-ups of the keyboard!

Also—after the notepad section,
there’s a part where I just go wild on the keys like a piano.
Even smashing them with my palms lol 😂
It’s oddly satisfying. (You’ll catch a preview of it too!)

Sweet dreams & half-night to you :) 🌙✨

but I’m not sure what the current price is.

so your eyes won’t get bored while watching 🫶

there’s a part where I just go wild on the keys like a piano.

This is a brand new keyboard I just bought,
and it sounds like pebbles rolling around.
Or maybe... bubbling stew? 🍲💭

Honestly…
I watched sooo many YouTube videos before deciding which keyboard to get 😂
I was super torn, but the moment I opened the box and felt the keystrokes, I was like:
“Wait… how does it sound this good??” 😭✨

I paid about 190,000 won (around $140 USD),
but I’m not sure what the current price is.
I’ll leave a shopping tag—click it if you’re curious!

This time I tried switching up the camera angles
so your eyes won’t get bored while watching 🫶

This is a brand new keyboard I just bought,
and it sounds like pebbles rolling around.
Or maybe... bubbling stew? 🍲💭

Honestly…
I watched sooo many YouTube videos before deciding which keyboard to get 😂
I was super torn, but the moment I opened the box and felt the keystrokes, I was like:
“Wait… how does it sound this good??” 😭✨
It really felt special. I just know I’ll be using this one for a long time.

I paid about 190,000 won (around $140 USD),
but I’m not sure what the current price is.
I’ll leave a shopping tag—click it if you’re curious!

And yes… I still have more to say ㅎㅎㅎㅎ

This time I tried switching up the camera angles
so your eyes won’t get bored while watching 🫶
You’ll see 3 shots: from the side, the front, and some close-ups of the keyboard!

Also—after the notepad section,
there’s a part where I just go wild on the keys like a piano.
Even smashing them with my palms lol 😂
It’s oddly satisfying. (You’ll catch a preview of it too!)

Sweet dreams & half-night to you :) 🌙✨

Hello there!
Today’s video is a keyboard typing ASMR where you can see the keyboard and the notepad onscreen at the same time. ㅋㅋㅋ!?

I figured… if I’m not going to talk, at least it should be fun to watch—so I opened up a notepad. 😆

In the later part of the video, I removed the notepad so you can fully focus on the keyboard sounds (It’s super sleep-inducing… Zzz)

This is a brand new keyboard I just bought,
and it sounds like pebbles rolling around.
Or maybe... bubbling stew? 🍲💭

Honestly…
I watched sooo many YouTube videos before deciding which keyboard to get 😂
I was super torn, but the moment I opened the box and felt the keystrokes, I was like:
“Wait… how does it sound this good??” 😭✨
It really felt special. I just know I’ll be using this one for a long time.

I paid about 190,000 won (around $140 USD),
but I’m not sure what the current price is.
I’ll leave a shopping tag—click it if you’re curious!

And yes… I still have more to say ㅎㅎㅎㅎ

This time I tried switching up the camera angles
so your eyes won’t get bored while watching 🫶
You’ll see 3 shots: from the side, the front, and some close-ups of the keyboard!

Also—after the notepad section,
there’s a part where I just go wild on the keys like a piano.
Even smashing them with my palms lol 😂
It’s oddly satisfying. (You’ll catch a preview of it too!)

Sweet dreams & half-night to you :) 🌙✨

소리를 3개를 레이어드 했더니 후시녹음이 풍성한 맛이!!
그리고 애교살 그리는 소리, 눈썹그리는 소리가 제 취향이였어요
저는 후시녹음 할 때 마이크를 여러개 사용해서 녹음하는 편인데요!
왜냐면, , 마이크마다 매력이 달라서 좀 더 어울리는 소리 찾느라 그래요 !ㅋㅋㅋ

[ 메이크업 정보 ]
저는 실제로 봄웜톤 , 봄 브라이트톤이에요!
화면에 보이는 섀도우팔레트나 블러셔는 제가 평소에 쓰는 내돈내산템이라
같은 봄웜이라면 후회하지 않으실 겁니다ㅋㅋ
그것말고 협찬품이 있는데요! 립제품들은 롬앤에서 협찬해주셨던 제품이에요
블러퍼지틴트가... 대박 이쁘더라구요. 매트한건데 주름끼임이 없고 블러처리 한것처럼 되요! 놀랠만큼 좋아서 정말 계속 쓸 것 같아요
물틴트도 정말 좋아요! 반짝반짝 탱글탱글 입술 표현에 딱! 얘는 향도 좋아요ㅠㅠ!
얘네들도 후회하지 않으실 거에요 ㅋㅋ

잘자요 반나잇 :)

Hello everyone! It's Ban Bo-Young, revealing a little bit of my face!
LOL
Well… just my lips, though.
I show them about three times throughout the video.
Hahaha 😂

Today's video is in vertical format,
so hold your phone upright like you're watching Shorts!!

Shall I introduce today’s roleplay scenario?
Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!
But guess what? She did her makeup all wrong and came to me for help.
I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…
Last time, I did an ear-cleaning ASMR for my younger brother, who is the youngest in our family!
And now, it’s my second sibling’s turn…
Being the eldest is seriously exhausting… LOL 😅
But I always show them love in my own way.
I even worry about whether her crush is a good guy.
And of course, we chat about our childhood memories while having fun together.

Sounds in This Video 🎧
ALL makeup sounds are fully recorded in post-production!
This time, lip makeup sounds are extra rich!
I layered three different sound sources, and the final mix turned out super satisfying!
Also, the aegyo-sal pencil and eyebrow drawing sounds were totally my style.
I usually record with multiple microphones because each one has its own unique charm.
I just love experimenting to find the perfect sound! LOL 🎤✨

[ Makeup Info ]
I'm a Spring Warm Tone / Spring Bright Tone in real life!
The eyeshadow palettes and blushes you see in the video are my personal, self-purchased items.
So if you're also a Spring Warm, you won’t regret using them! LOL

As for sponsored products, Rom&nd kindly sent me some lip tints! 💄
Their Blur Fudge Tint is AMAZING!
It’s matte but doesn’t settle into lip lines, giving a soft, blurred effect. I love it so much that I’ll keep using it for sure!
Their Water Tint is also fantastic—it makes your lips look glossy and plump with a juicy shine!
And the scent? Absolutely delightful! 😍
You won’t regret trying these either! LOL

Good night, Ban-night! 🌙✨

Hello everyone! It's Ban Bo-Young, revealing a little bit of my face!
LOL
Well… just my lips, though.
I show them about three times throughout the video.
Hahaha 😂

Today's video is in vertical format,
so hold your phone upright like you're watching Shorts!!

Shall I introduce today’s roleplay scenario?
Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!
But guess what? She did her makeup all wrong and came to me for help.
I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…
Last time, I did an ear-cleaning ASMR for my younger brother, who is the youngest in our family!
And now, it’s my second sibling’s turn…
Being the eldest is seriously exhausting… LOL 😅
But I always show them love in my own way.
I even worry about whether her crush is a good guy.
And of course, we chat about our childhood memories while having fun together.

Sounds in This Video 🎧
ALL makeup sounds are fully recorded in post-production!
This time, lip makeup sounds are extra rich!
I layered three different sound sources, and the final mix turned out super satisfying!

The eyeshadow palettes and blushes you see in the video are my personal, self-purchased items.

Their Water Tint is also fantastic—it makes your lips look glossy and plump with a juicy shine!
And the scent? Absolutely delightful! 😍
You won’t regret trying these either! LOL

Good night, Ban-night! 🌙✨

I show them about three times throughout the video.

Today's video is in vertical format,

Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!
But guess what? She did her makeup all wrong and came to me for help.
I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…
Last time, I did an ear-cleaning ASMR for my younger brother, who is the youngest in our family!
And now, it’s my second sibling’s turn…
Being the eldest is seriously exhausting… LOL 😅
But I always show them love in my own way.
I even worry about whether her crush is a good guy.
And of course, we chat about our childhood memories while having fun together.

Sounds in This Video 🎧
ALL makeup sounds are fully recorded in post-production!
This time, lip makeup sounds are extra rich!
I layered three different sound sources, and the final mix turned out super satisfying!
Also, the aegyo-sal pencil and eyebrow drawing sounds were totally my style.
I usually record with multiple microphones because each one has its own unique charm.

The eyeshadow palettes and blushes you see in the video are my personal, self-purchased items.

It’s matte but doesn’t settle into lip lines, giving a soft, blurred effect. I love it so much that I’ll keep using it for sure!
Their Water Tint is also fantastic—it makes your lips look glossy and plump with a juicy shine!
And the scent? Absolutely delightful! 😍
You won’t regret trying these either! LOL

Good night, Ban-night! 🌙✨

Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!

I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…
Last time, I did an ear-cleaning ASMR for my younger brother, who is the youngest in our family!

Hello everyone! It's Ban Bo-Young, revealing a little bit of my face!
LOL
Well… just my lips, though.
I show them about three times throughout the video.
Hahaha 😂

Today's video is in vertical format,
so hold your phone upright like you're watching Shorts!!

Shall I introduce today’s roleplay scenario?
Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!
But guess what? She did her makeup all wrong and came to me for help.
I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…
Last time, I did an ear-cleaning ASMR for my younger brother, who is the youngest in our family!
And now, it’s my second sibling’s turn…
Being the eldest is seriously exhausting… LOL 😅
But I always show them love in my own way.
I even worry about whether her crush is a good guy.
And of course, we chat about our childhood memories while having fun together.

Sounds in This Video 🎧
ALL makeup sounds are fully recorded in post-production!
This time, lip makeup sounds are extra rich!
I layered three different sound sources, and the final mix turned out super satisfying!
Also, the aegyo-sal pencil and eyebrow drawing sounds were totally my style.
I usually record with multiple microphones because each one has its own unique charm.
I just love experimenting to find the perfect sound! LOL 🎤✨

[ Makeup Info ]
I'm a Spring Warm Tone / Spring Bright Tone in real life!
The eyeshadow palettes and blushes you see in the video are my personal, self-purchased items.
So if you're also a Spring Warm, you won’t regret using them! LOL

As for sponsored products, Rom&nd kindly sent me some lip tints! 💄
Their Blur Fudge Tint is AMAZING!
It’s matte but doesn’t settle into lip lines, giving a soft, blurred effect. I love it so much that I’ll keep using it for sure!
Their Water Tint is also fantastic—it makes your lips look glossy and plump with a juicy shine!
And the scent? Absolutely delightful! 😍
You won’t regret trying these either! LOL

Good night, Ban-night! 🌙✨

중간중간 3번정도 공개해요
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ

자! 오늘 상황극 내용 소개 할까요?

메이크업을 엉망진창으로 한채로 저한테 고쳐달라고 온거에요

지난번에 귀청소 해준 남동생은 막내동생 이였는데요!

이번에는 립메이크업 소리가 풍성할거에요!
소리를 3개를 레이어드 했더니 후시녹음이 풍성한 맛이!!

+
[ 메이크업 정보 ]
저는 실제로 봄웜톤 , 봄 브라이트톤이에요!
화면에 보이는 섀도우팔레트나 블러셔는 제가 평소에 쓰는 내돈내산템이라
같은 봄웜이라면 후회하지 않으실 겁니다ㅋㅋ
그것말고 협찬품이 있는데요! 립제품들은 롬앤에서 협찬해주셨던 제품이에요
블러퍼지틴트가... 대박 이쁘더라구요. 매트한건데 주름끼임이 없고 블러처리 한것처럼 되요! 놀랠만큼 좋아서 정말 계속 쓸 것 같아요
물틴트도 정말 좋아요! 반짝반짝 탱글탱글 입술 표현에 딱! 얘는 향도 좋아요ㅠㅠ!
얘네들도 후회하지 않으실 거에요 ㅋㅋ

잘자요 반나잇 :)

얘네들도 후회하지 않으실 거에요 ㅋㅋ

Hello everyone! It's Ban Bo-Young, revealing a little bit of my face!
LOL
Well… just my lips, though.
I show them about three times throughout the video.
Hahaha 😂

Today's video is in vertical format,

Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!
But guess what? She did her makeup all wrong and came to me for help.
I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…
Last time, I did an ear-cleaning ASMR for my younger brother, who is the youngest in our family!
And now, it’s my second sibling’s turn…
Being the eldest is seriously exhausting… LOL 😅
But I always show them love in my own way.
I even worry about whether her crush is a good guy.
And of course, we chat about our childhood memories while having fun together.

Sounds in This Video 🎧
ALL makeup sounds are fully recorded in post-production!

I just love experimenting to find the perfect sound! LOL 🎤✨

Their Water Tint is also fantastic—it makes your lips look glossy and plump with a juicy shine!
And the scent? Absolutely delightful! 😍
You won’t regret trying these either! LOL

Good night, Ban-night! 🌙✨

Hello everyone! It's Ban Bo-Young, revealing a little bit of my face!
LOL
Well… just my lips, though.
I show them about three times throughout the video.
Hahaha 😂

Today's video is in vertical format,
so hold your phone upright like you're watching Shorts!!

Shall I introduce today’s roleplay scenario?
Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!
But guess what? She did her makeup all wrong and came to me for help.
I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…
Last time, I did an ear-cleaning ASMR for my younger brother, who is the youngest in our family!
And now, it’s my second sibling’s turn…
Being the eldest is seriously exhausting… LOL 😅
But I always show them love in my own way.
I even worry about whether her crush is a good guy.
And of course, we chat about our childhood memories while having fun together.

Sounds in This Video 🎧
ALL makeup sounds are fully recorded in post-production!
This time, lip makeup sounds are extra rich!
I layered three different sound sources, and the final mix turned out super satisfying!
Also, the aegyo-sal pencil and eyebrow drawing sounds were totally my style.
I usually record with multiple microphones because each one has its own unique charm.
I just love experimenting to find the perfect sound! LOL 🎤✨

[ Makeup Info ]
I'm a Spring Warm Tone / Spring Bright Tone in real life!
The eyeshadow palettes and blushes you see in the video are my personal, self-purchased items.
So if you're also a Spring Warm, you won’t regret using them! LOL

As for sponsored products, Rom&nd kindly sent me some lip tints! 💄
Their Blur Fudge Tint is AMAZING!
It’s matte but doesn’t settle into lip lines, giving a soft, blurred effect. I love it so much that I’ll keep using it for sure!
Their Water Tint is also fantastic—it makes your lips look glossy and plump with a juicy shine!
And the scent? Absolutely delightful! 😍
You won’t regret trying these either! LOL

Good night, Ban-night! 🌙✨

I show them about three times throughout the video.

Today's video is in vertical format,

Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!

ALL makeup sounds are fully recorded in post-production!

썸남이 괜찮은 사람인지 걱정도 해주고
어릴적 이야기도 하면서 도란도란 수다도 떨어요

소리를 소개할게요
메이크업 하는 소리!!!몽땅!후시녹음!
이번에는 립메이크업 소리가 풍성할거에요!
소리를 3개를 레이어드 했더니 후시녹음이 풍성한 맛이!!
그리고 애교살 그리는 소리, 눈썹그리는 소리가 제 취향이였어요
저는 후시녹음 할 때 마이크를 여러개 사용해서 녹음하는 편인데요!
왜냐면, , 마이크마다 매력이 달라서 좀 더 어울리는 소리 찾느라 그래요 !ㅋㅋㅋ

+
[ 메이크업 정보 ]
저는 실제로 봄웜톤 , 봄 브라이트톤이에요!
화면에 보이는 섀도우팔레트나 블러셔는 제가 평소에 쓰는 내돈내산템이라
같은 봄웜이라면 후회하지 않으실 겁니다ㅋㅋ
그것말고 협찬품이 있는데요! 립제품들은 롬앤에서 협찬해주셨던 제품이에요
블러퍼지틴트가... 대박 이쁘더라구요. 매트한건데 주름끼임이 없고 블러처리 한것처럼 되요! 놀랠만큼 좋아서 정말 계속 쓸 것 같아요
물틴트도 정말 좋아요! 반짝반짝 탱글탱글 입술 표현에 딱! 얘는 향도 좋아요ㅠㅠ!
얘네들도 후회하지 않으실 거에요 ㅋㅋ

잘자요 반나잇 :)

Hello everyone! It's Ban Bo-Young, revealing a little bit of my face!
LOL
Well… just my lips, though.
I show them about three times throughout the video.
Hahaha 😂

Today's video is in vertical format,
so hold your phone upright like you're watching Shorts!!

Shall I introduce today’s roleplay scenario?
Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!
But guess what? She did her makeup all wrong and came to me for help.
I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…
Last time, I did an ear-cleaning ASMR for my younger brother, who is the youngest in our family!
And now, it’s my second sibling’s turn…
Being the eldest is seriously exhausting… LOL 😅
But I always show them love in my own way.
I even worry about whether her crush is a good guy.
And of course, we chat about our childhood memories while having fun together.

Sounds in This Video 🎧
ALL makeup sounds are fully recorded in post-production!
This time, lip makeup sounds are extra rich!
I layered three different sound sources, and the final mix turned out super satisfying!
Also, the aegyo-sal pencil and eyebrow drawing sounds were totally my style.
I usually record with multiple microphones because each one has its own unique charm.
I just love experimenting to find the perfect sound! LOL 🎤✨

[ Makeup Info ]
I'm a Spring Warm Tone / Spring Bright Tone in real life!
The eyeshadow palettes and blushes you see in the video are my personal, self-purchased items.
So if you're also a Spring Warm, you won’t regret using them! LOL

As for sponsored products, Rom&nd kindly sent me some lip tints! 💄
Their Blur Fudge Tint is AMAZING!
It’s matte but doesn’t settle into lip lines, giving a soft, blurred effect. I love it so much that I’ll keep using it for sure!
Their Water Tint is also fantastic—it makes your lips look glossy and plump with a juicy shine!
And the scent? Absolutely delightful! 😍
You won’t regret trying these either! LOL

Good night, Ban-night! 🌙✨

Hello everyone! It's Ban Bo-Young, revealing a little bit of my face!

I show them about three times throughout the video.

Today's video is in vertical format,

Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!

I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…

Today, my younger sister (the second sibling, Ban Bomi) is meeting her crush!

I had just woken up, so my grumpy mode was ON…

#asmr귀청소 #asmrearcleaning #asmrPOV

오늘은 숏츠처럼 세로형으로 보세요! 
반보영 입니다ㅋㅋ오늘 영상 특이하죠!
귀청소를 누워서 하는 상황극 입니다
아마 휴대폰에서 전체화면 눌르면 화면에 꽉 찰거에요!ㅋㅋ

이 집은 삼남매 인데요
저는 큰누나구요. 귀파달라는 애는 막내 남동생이에요
그래서 나이차이가 좀 나는 동생이랑 대화하는 느낌이 날거에요

남동생이 누나 깨워서 귀좀 파달라고 하는 상황이에요
설정이 좀 까칠한 누나라서
좀 까칠할 수 있습니다 ㅋㅋ

만사가 귀찮은
귀차니즘 심한 누나라서
일어나지도 않고 침대에서 귀청소 합니다.

소리는 역시나 귀청소ㅎㅎㅎ

ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
근데 눈이 많이 온다더라구요
귀성길 조심히 다녀오세요!!

snippet.title: ASMR(English Speak)🔥Cozy Fireplace with a Friend(Crackling Fire sounds,Adding Log)Talking&No Talking
snippet.description:
#asmrfireplace #asmr모닥불 #asmrfriend

불멍계의 레전드 asmr을 찍고싶었던 반보영 입니다.
모닥불 소리를 섬세하게 만들어 봤어요
그 불멍 할때 보면요.
장작을 불에 던질때마다 타다닷! 하는 소리가 좀 크게 나잖아요?
그걸 좋아해서 그 소리가 나게끔 만들었어요!
실감나는 느낌을 원했거든요!!
그래서 오늘 여러번 장작을 불에 던져요!!ㅋㅋ

상황은요,
캠핑하러 펜션에 친구랑 놀러온 상황극 이에요!
펜션 내부의 벽난로 모닥불에 장작을 넣으며 불멍을 때립니다
(나뭇가지랑 나무조각을 넣어요!ㅋㅋ)

그 저기 .. 할말이 있어요!
불멍계의 레전드를 만들고 싶다는 욕심에 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ..
처음 합성? 같은 것을 해보아서 화면이 ?
약간.....부자연 스러울 ..아니
많이... 웃길거에요ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 
그리하여 화면을 많이 어둡게 하시거나 
눈을 감고 들으시는 것을 추천드립니다
나중에는 좀 더 자연스러운 CG를? 만들 수 있도록 노력할게요 !

이거 하나 해보니깐.....

처음 합성? 같은 것을 해보아서 화면이 ?

많이... 부자연 스러울 거에요

모닥불 소리가 듣고싶을 만큼 요즘 많이 춥더라구요 !
오늘영상에서 힐링 하셨으면 좋겠습니다

As I mentioned in the first line, I had this ambition to create a legendary campfire experience LOL...
So it’s my first time trying something like compositing, and well...

ro.description:
#asmrfireplace #asmr모닥불 #asmrfriend

불멍계의 레전드 asmr을 찍고싶었던 반보영 입니다.
모닥불 소리를 섬세하게 만들어 봤어요
장작을 불에 던질때마다 타다닷! 하는 소리가 나게끔 만들었어요!
실감나는 느낌을 원했거든요!!

상황은요,
캠핑하러 펜션에 친구랑 놀러온 상황극 이에요!
펜션 내부의 벽난로 모닥불에 장작을 넣으며 불멍을 때립니다
(나뭇가지랑 나무조각을 넣어요!ㅋㅋ)

그 저기 .. 할말이 있어요!
불멍계의 레전드를 만들고 싶다는 욕심에 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ..
처음 합성? 같은 것을 해보아서 화면이 ?
약간.....부자연 스러울 ..아니
많이... 웃길거에요ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 
그리하여 화면을 많이 어둡게 하시거나 
눈을 감고 들으시는 것을 추천드립니다
나중에는 좀 더 자연스러운 CG를? 만들 수 있도록 노력할게요 ! 

그래서 원래 영어버전 한국어버전 두개다 할려고 했는데
이거 하나 해보니깐.....
합성이 웃겨가지구 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
한국어 버전을 만들지는 반쪽이들의 피드백 보고 생각해볼려고 해요 ㅋㅋ

모닥불 소리가 듣고싶을 만큼 요즘 많이 춥더라구요 !
소리는 그래도 좋으니깐 소리로 힐링 많이하세요!
피드백 꼭 줘야해요!!ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ

This is Ban Bo-young, who wanted to create the ASMR legend of the campfire world."
I tried to make the crackling sound of the campfire as delicate as possible.
Every time a log is thrown into the fire, it goes crackle pop!
I really wanted to make it feel realistic!!

So, here’s the setting:
It’s a roleplay where I’m camping at a pension with a friend!
We’re sitting by the fireplace inside the pension, adding logs to the fire and enjoying the campfire vibes.
(We’re putting in twigs and pieces of wood! LOL)

Oh, by the way, I have something to say!
As I mentioned in the first line, I had this ambition to create a legendary campfire experience LOL...
So it’s my first time trying something like compositing, and well...
The visuals might be... slightly... no, very unnatural. 😂
So I recommend either making the screen really dark or just closing your eyes and listening instead.
I’ll try to create more natural CG in the future!

It’s been so cold lately that it makes you want to hear the sound of a crackling fire!
I hope today’s video brings you some healing. 😊

처음 합성? 같은 것을 해보아서 화면이 ?

snippet.description:
#asmr #asmrsounds #asmr마이크터칭

안녕하세요!
오늘은 맨손,목도리,장갑 으로 마이크터칭 하는 겨울감성 가득한 영상입니다.
마이크를 꾹꾹 누르기도 하고, 긁어보기도 하고
이어커핑처럼 귀를 막는 소리를 내보기도 해요!
목도리로 마이크를 덮고, 묶고?
다양한 마이크 터칭으로 귀 팅글을 느껴보시면 좋겠어요!!

오늘은 감사하게도 
 '롸잇히어'에서 목도리, 장갑, 목걸이를 보내주셨는데요!
그 중에서 제가 찐으로 추천하는 템은 어떤 것일지!!영상에서 확인해주세요!

그리고
저번에 3dio pro2 마이크 개봉기 했을때
제가 쓴 자막에 대한 반응이 좋으셨던 것 같아서
오늘도 약간 요동치는 자막!? 그런 거 해봤습니다

이제 새해네요 여러분

지난번 우리나라에 안타까운 사고가 있어서
뉴스를 며칠 떼놓을 수 없었는데요.
깊은 애도의 마음으로 잊지않겠습니다.

정말 항상 반쪽이 여러분도 건강하시고요
안전하시길 바라며
2025년 새해는 복만 많이 받으셨음 하는 바램입니다

오늘 밤도 편안한 밤 되시길 바랍니다

Today's video is filled with winter vibes, featuring mic-touching sounds using bare hands, a muffler, and gloves.

You’ll also see me covering and tying the mic with a muffler.

Today, I’m grateful to share that the muffler, gloves, and necklace were kindly sent to me by 'Right Here'!

your feedback on my captions was amazing!
So, I’ve added some fun, dynamic captions again today!

Recently, there was a tragic incident in our country,
and I couldn’t stay away from the news for days.
With a heavy heart, I’ll always remember and honor those lost.

To all my dear Banjjok(subscribers name), I truly hope you stay healthy and safe.
Wishing you a New Year in 2025 filled with nothing but happiness and blessings.

Have a peaceful night tonight as well! 🌙

snippet.title: ASMR 산타마을 1인칭 귀청소샵🎅(헛소리 가득)|체온계,귀소독,여러가지귀이개,100%수면유도 | 크리스마스 특집🎄Santa's Village Ear Cleaning(SUB)
snippet.description:
#asmr #asmr귀파기 #asmr귀청소

안녕하세요! 메리크리스마스~!!
크리스마스 특집으로 산타마을 귀청소샵을 공개합니다 :)
1인칭 구도의 특유의 잠이 솔솔오는 그  느낌!
오늘은 루돌프에게 귀청소를 받아보세요
지난번 투표때 1인칭 귀청소샵 3탄을 원하시는 분들이 많으셨어요
감동적이였었다는 ㅠㅠ! 
평범한것보다 특별하게 만들고싶었는데 마침 크리스마스가 다가오고 있었더랩죠
ㅎㅎ그렇다면 특집이다!

[내용요약]
오늘 많이 헛소리해요 ㅋㅋ판타지라서 신나서 헛소리좀 했습니다
산타마을은 지구밖에 있는데요(옛날 산타마을 관련영상을 보시면 이야기가 이어집니다)
착한일 많이해야 올수있어요!
5년만에 온 손님이 저(루돌프)를 알아보더라고요
저는 5년이 지난만큼 뿔이 더 많이 자랐습니다
지구인들은 요즘엔 산타를 안믿는다고 하네요?진짜 있는데!
중간중간 재밌는 이야기가 많으니까 직접 들어주세요!

[소리요약]
이번영상은 귀지상태를 보고 그때그때 도구를 바꾸는 방식이에요!
각종 귀이개 많이 나와요
양쪽 동시 귀청소는 중간이후에 몰려있는데
소리가 짱입니다....
아 구름칼 귓바퀴청소도 있어요
나무귀이개, 쇠귀이개,비녀,실리콘,치과도구,솜털,핀셋,면봉....등등등
체온재는소리, 스퀴즈로 귀먼지를 떼내는 소리
귀소독도 있어요

모두 산타마을 꿈 꾸세요 ~~

[영상에 나오는 하트조명은 알리에서 샀어요!]
하트조명 링크:https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_oFfQJxV

localized.description:
#asmr #asmr귀파기 #asmr귀청소

안녕하세요! 메리크리스마스~!!
크리스마스 특집으로 산타마을 귀청소샵을 공개합니다 :)
1인칭 구도의 특유의 잠이 솔솔오는 그  느낌!
오늘은 루돌프에게 귀청소를 받아보세요
지난번 투표때 1인칭 귀청소샵 3탄을 원하시는 분들이 많으셨어요
감동적이였었다는 ㅠㅠ! 
평범한것보다 특별하게 만들고싶었는데 마침 크리스마스가 다가오고 있었더랩죠
ㅎㅎ그렇다면 특집이다!

[내용요약]
오늘 많이 헛소리해요 ㅋㅋ판타지라서 신나서 헛소리좀 했습니다
산타마을은 지구밖에 있는데요(옛날 산타마을 관련영상을 보시면 이야기가 이어집니다)
착한일 많이해야 올수있어요!
5년만에 온 손님이 저(루돌프)를 알아보더라고요
저는 5년이 지난만큼 뿔이 더 많이 자랐습니다
지구인들은 요즘엔 산타를 안믿는다고 하네요?진짜 있는데!
중간중간 재밌는 이야기가 많으니까 직접 들어주세요!

[소리요약]
이번영상은 귀지상태를 보고 그때그때 도구를 바꾸는 방식이에요!
각종 귀이개 많이 나와요
양쪽 동시 귀청소는 중간이후에 몰려있는데
소리가 짱입니다....
아 구름칼 귓바퀴청소도 있어요
나무귀이개, 쇠귀이개,비녀,실리콘,치과도구,솜털,핀셋,면봉....등등등
체온재는소리, 스퀴즈로 귀먼지를 떼내는 소리
귀소독도 있어요

모두 산타마을 꿈 꾸세요 ~~
